entries.en: §EThe §HSpaceport§! is equipped with a heavy armament of §HTorpedo§! weapons as its main defense.§!

entries.zh: §E这个§H太空港§!太空港装配了大量的§H光束武器§!用作它的防御系统。光束武器科技的进步将继续提升这个太空港的防御能力。§!
entries.en: §EThe §HSpaceport§! is equipped with a heavy armament of §HLaser§! weapons as its main defense.§!

entries.zh: §E这个§H太空港§!装配了大量的§H动能武器§!用作它的防御系统。动能武器科技的进步将继续提升这个太空港的防御能力。§!
entries.en: §EThe §HSpaceport§! is equipped with a heavy armament of §HProjectile§! weapons as its main defense.§!

entries.zh: 为星舰舰员提供便利和补给以减少舰队停泊于此地的后勤负担。\n
entries.en: Provides accommodation and support for spaceship crews, reducing the logistical burden on fleets that are berthed here.\n

entries.zh: 将停泊在此的舰队与太空站的核心智能想连接的连接管，使得舰队的整修得以实现。\n
entries.en: Service Umbilicals connect berthed fleets directly to the core intelligence of the station, allowing it to assist with repairs and refits.\n

entries.zh: 就地直接孕育生养子个体舰员的能力是对此处舰队后勤方面的一大裨益。\n
entries.en: The ability to birth and gestate crew drones directly on-site is a logistical boon to local fleets.\n

entries.zh: 为了能让新招募的船员准备应对战斗，必须有能干的长官来领导他们。舰队学院将确保这些长官充分理解最新的学说，并熟练掌握星际战争。
entries.en: For our newly recruited crews to be truly combat ready, they must have capable officers leading them. The Fleet Academy will ensure those officers have up-to-date knowledge on the doctrines and practice of interstellar warfare.

entries.zh: 通过反复模拟各种战斗场景，我们的战斗无人机将对真正的战斗有更好的准备。
entries.en: Repeated simulation of various battle scenarios will better prepare our shipboard combat drones for real combat.

entries.zh: 抛弃了干船坞的传统概念，巨像会由大量行动自如的独立建造平台组装而成。\n
entries.en: Abandoning the traditional concept of drydocks, colossal spaceships are assembled by a number of highly mobile independent construction platforms.\n

entries.zh: 安装在恒星基地外的专用干船坞让我们能够建造恢弘的泰坦级战舰。\n
entries.en: Specialized drydocks erected on the Starbase's hull allow for the construction of gargantuan Titan-class ships.\n

entries.zh: 安装在恒星基地外的专用干船坞，辅以具有高机动性的自由建造平台，使我们可以建造恢弘的主力舰。所能建造的舰船类型会随着科技的发展而不断扩增。\n
entries.en: Specialized drydocks erected on the Starbase's hull, supplemented by highly mobile independent construction platforms, enable the assembly of gargantuan capital-class vessels. The range of ships that can be constructed expands as new technologies are developed.\n

entries.zh: 每座船坞一次只能建造一艘舰船，与其他船坞互不干扰。\n
entries.en: A Shipyard may build one ship at a time, in parallel with other Shipyards.\n

entries.zh: 为恒星基地添加两个中型的武器槽位。\n
entries.en: Adds two medium-size weapon slots to the Starbase.\n

entries.zh: 为恒星基地增添两个制导武器槽。\n
entries.en: Adds two guided weapon slots to the Starbase.\n

entries.zh: 一个行商和卖家间进行商业贸易的民用停泊区。\n
entries.en: A civilian docking area where merchants and traders can conduct business.\n

entries.zh: 舰队锚地对于支撑舰队成长是不可或缺的。\n
entries.en: Fleet anchorages are necessary to support the growth of our navy.\n

entries.zh: 为恒星基地添加一个舰载机机库。\n
entries.en: Adds a hangar for Strike Craft to the Starbase.\n

entries.zh: 用于支持该星系中资源采集操作的机库和仓库。
entries.en: Hangars and warehouses to support resource collecting operations in the system.

entries.zh: 只要恒星基地仍在运作，超光速抑制器便会阻止敌舰沿进入星系的超空间航道以外的任何航道离开。
entries.en: While the Starbase is still operational, its FTL inhibitor prevents enemy ships from leaving the system along any other hyperlane than the one they entered from.

entries.zh: 这些强力的扰乱装置干扰了舰艇间的通讯，使得协调舰队行动变得十分困难。\n
entries.en: These powerful jammers interfere with enemy ship-to-ship communications, making it difficult to coordinate fleet movements.\n

entries.zh: 通过激发星系内敌方舰船周围亚原子的局域场，能够显著地弱化他们护盾的效果。\n
entries.en: Generates localized fields of agitated subatomic particles around hostile ships in the system, significantly reducing the effectiveness of their shields.\n

entries.zh: 通过辨别进入超空间的理想条件并优化其行程路线，来协助系内友方舰船的超光速航行。\n
entries.en: Assists friendly ships with FTL travel in the system by identifying ideal conditions for hyperlane entry, and optimizing projected travel routes.\n

entries.zh: 专门用于非军事舰船的基础设施，保证交通运输网能够平稳便利地运行。\n
entries.en: Dedicated infrastructure for non-military vessels, enabling a smooth and convenient transit network.\n

entries.zh: 除非受限于其他移民管控条例，该恒星系的失业§Y工人§!和§Y子个体§!人口将会自动§Y移民§!到其他宜居性合适、有空余住房和岗位、并且所在恒星系也拥有§Y运输枢纽§!的殖民地。\n\n
entries.en: Unemployed §YWorker§! and §YDrone§! Pops from this system will - unless subjected to other migration controls - automatically §YMigrate§! to other colonies with decent habitability, free housing and jobs, in systems which have §YTransit Hubs§!.\n\n

entries.zh: 在该恒星系内，失业的§Y$SLAVES$§!和无智慧机器人允许向其他殖民地§Y自动迁移§!。
entries.en: §YAutomatic Resettlement§! to other colonies is enabled for unemployed §Y$SLAVES$§! and non-sapient robots in this system.

entries.zh: 所有系内防御都是由这个深藏于恒星基地内部的大型设施所协调的。星图阵列和立体投影使任何时间所有经此星系的空间航行都无所遁形。\n
entries.en: All system defense efforts are coordinated from this large facility, buried deep within the hull of the Starbase. Map arrays and 3D projections track all space traffic passing through the system at any given time.\n

entries.zh: 一个调整恒星基地防御平台的相对轨道与射击弧线的强大的超级计算机，其增加了可支持的防御平台数目。\n
entries.en: A powerful supercomputer coordinating the relative orbit and firing arcs of the Starbase's defense platforms, increasing the number of defense platforms that can be supported.\n

entries.zh: 致力于改善星际贸易环境的非政府组织。\n
entries.en: The offices of a non-governmental organ dedicated to improving the conditions of interstellar trade.\n

entries.zh: 我们能够通过处理星云里的尘埃云来提取和精炼有价值的矿物。\n
entries.en: By processing the dust clouds of a nebula, we are able to refine and extract valuable minerals.\n

entries.zh: 监听哨站驻有一队专门分析超空间回响的操作员，这有效地扩展了恒星基地传感器的作用范围。\n
entries.en: The Listening Post houses a team of dedicated operators tasked with analyzing hyperlane reverberations, functionally extending the range of the Starbase's sensors.\n

entries.zh: 一个不值一提但仍存在的官僚机构，理论上提高了恒星基地锚地的容量。\n
entries.en: A minimal-but-extant bureaucratic layer increases the theoretical capacity of the Starbase's Anchorages.\n

entries.zh: 通过建造专门用于研究恒星天体的特种科学设施，我们帝国的认知水平必将得到提升。\n
entries.en: By building a specialized science facilities dedicated to studying stellar objects, our empire will surely be able to see improvements in our understanding.\n

entries.zh: 产出取决于当地恒星等级
entries.en: Output depends on local Star Class.

entries.zh: 这座恒星基地的大部分都被划为官方否认其存在的秘密基地。整个星系都受到其严密监控，而情报人员则小心地操纵当地媒体与社交活动。\n
entries.en: A large part of this Starbase has been set aside as a Black Site that does not officially exist. The entire system is closely monitored from here, while intelligence operatives carefully manipulate local media and social events to the best of their ability.\n

entries.zh: 巨大的资源仓储设施，可以安全地保存大量资源。
entries.en: Massive resource silos and storage facilities where large quantities of resources can be safely kept.

entries.zh: 通过将这座恒星基地的一部分划为水培农场，空间站将可以自给自足，甚至可以出口一部分多余作物至其它恒星系。
entries.en: By dedicating a section of this Starbase to Hydroponic farming, the station will be able to feed itself and even export excess produce to other systems.

entries.zh: 一台先进的目标计算机可以收集并分析来自星系内其它盟友传感器的数据。这使得恒星基地可以更容易算出射击方案。\n
entries.en: An advanced targeting computer that collects and analyzes data from all friendly sensor sources in-system. This makes it far easier for the Starbase to achieve targeting solutions.\n

entries.zh: 通过建立一个完全致力于学习策展人并与其合作的研究机构，我们能够为我们的科学进步作出重大贡献。\n
entries.en: By constructing a research facility entirely focused on learning from, and cooperating with, the Curators, we are able to make significant contributions to our scientific progress.\n

entries.zh: 这所零重力艺术学院与附近的艺术家城邦合作，其才华横溢的学生的画笔下流泻出对外太空壮美景观的赞颂。\n
entries.en: This zero-g Art College, operated in conjunction with the nearby Artisan Enclave, celebrates the beauty of outer space in the works produced by its talented students.\n

entries.zh: 这座熙熙攘攘的附属建筑为我们的工程团队配备了丰富的工具和零件，这将使我们与附近的太空城邦开展更密切的合作。\n
entries.en: This bustling annex equips our engineering teams with a cornucopia of tools and spare parts, facilitating closer collaboration with the nearby Salvager Enclave.\n

entries.zh: 一座用于在该星系中生成一处虚境隧道的灵能信标。虚境信标被拆解或毁坏时，隧道也会被移除。\n
entries.en: A psionic Beacon used to spawn a Shroud Tunnel in this system. While the Shroud Beacon may be dismantled (or destroyed), the Tunnel itself cannot be removed.\n

entries.zh: 驻扎着雇佣军事人员的一批军营。这些鬓发灰白的老兵为剩下的人员安排常规操练，并随时准备防御恒星基地——只要给的钱管够。\n
entries.en: A collection of barracks hosting military contractors. These grizzled veterans organize regular drills for the rest of the crew, and stand ready to defend the station - as long as we pay them.\n

entries.zh: 这些办公室和处理设施为我们在星系中采集资源的工作提供工程师和协调员。精心优化的卓越仓储流程能让我们以前所未有的效率开采当地的矿藏。\n
entries.en: These offices and processing facilities house engineers and coordinators for our resource gathering operations in the system. With careful optimization, and superior storage processes, we are able to harvest local deposits with unprecedented efficiency.\n

entries.zh: 航天采矿湾模块：\n 开采站产出：§G+10%§!
entries.en: Astro-Mining Bays Modules:\n Mining Stations Output: §G+10%§!

entries.zh: §Y进攻部队中心§!提供了一种组建大量进攻部队的简易方法。部队将会在该星域内可用的所有行星上进行组建。\n\n在完成后，他们会增援到开启了§Y集合陆军部队§!的§Y陆军§!，或是在该恒星基地集合。
entries.en: The §YAssault Army Hub§! provides an easy way to assemble a large number of Assault Armies. Armies will be assembled on available planets in this Sector.\n\nUpon completion, they will reinforce any §YArmy§! with §YRally Troops§! enabled or gathered at this Starbase.

entries.zh: 可用£colony£§Y殖民地§!数量决定了可以同时建造多少支陆军。可以在$concept_colony_view$的$colony_view_tab_armies$页面中将一颗行星从§Y进攻部队中心§!中排除。
entries.en: The number of available £colony£§YColonies§! determines how many armies can be built in parallel. Colonies can be excluded from the §YAssault Army Hub§! in the $colony_view_tab_armies$ tab of the $concept_colony_view$.

entries.zh: 切换新建立的§Y陆军§!是部署于§Y轨道§!上还是§Y行星§!上。\n\n通过§Y恒星基地陆军建造功能§!建造的§Y陆军§!仍会部署在§Y轨道§!上。
entries.en: Toggles if newly built §YArmies§! should deploy in §YOrbit§! or on the §YPlanet§!.\n\n§YArmies§! built via the §YStarbase Army Builder§! will still deploy in §YOrbit§!.

entries.zh: §H尚未调查§!\n该行星尚未被我国调查。调查它将显示其可能蕴含的战略资源和引起特别注意的异常现象。\n§G派艘指派有科学官的科研船去调查一下吧。§!
entries.en: §HNot Surveyed§!\nThis planet has yet to be surveyed by our Empire. Surveying it might reveal Strategic Resources as well as interesting Anomalies.\n§GSend a Science Ship with a Scientist to this planet to Survey it§!

entries.zh: 确定要删除$SECTOR|Y$星域？删除星域将取消当前所有建设队列，并使你获得对星域所有星球的控制权。该星域已累积的资源将全部丢失。
entries.en: Are you sure you wish to delete the $SECTOR|Y$ Sector? Deleting the Sector will remove all current construction queues and transfer the control over them to you. All the sector's stockpiled resources are lost.

entries.zh: §H轨道建筑槽位已被锁定§!\n为了能够利用这个轨道建筑槽位，我们必须通过研究相关科技以扩展我们的大空港。

entries.zh: §H殖民地建筑槽被锁定§!\n发展殖民地基础设施可以解锁殖民地的建筑槽位。达到$INFRASTRUCTURE|H$%设施即可解锁此槽位。

entries.zh: §H轨道建筑槽位已被锁定§!\n当太空港建成后，这些建筑槽位将被解锁。
entries.en: §HLocked Orbital Building Slot§!\nThese building slots will be unlocked when a Spaceport is built.

entries.zh: §E恒星类别会影响恒星系的形成方式，以及恒星系内各类星体的类型和形态。§!
entries.en: §EThe Star Class affects how the Star System was formed and the Class and type of the surrounding planetary objects.§!

entries.zh: 在这个行星的轨道上建造§H太空港§!后将可以建造宇宙舰船和其他星际航天器。同时它也作为恒星系内的驿站，具有基本的防御和通讯作用。§H太空港§!能够专门化发展为生产，防御或公共设施。
entries.en: Constructing a §HSpaceport§! in orbit around this planet will allow the production of spaceships and other interplanetary craft. It will also act as an anchor for our Empire within this system, providing basic defenses and communications. The §HSpaceport§! can be further focused towards production, defense or utility as it grows.

entries.en: Force an unconditional Status Quo offer to end this war as a tie.

entries.en: Sending an unconditional surrender will end the war immediately and give the enemy 6 months to dictate terms.

entries.en: §ROur war goal does not permit us to do this.§!

entries.zh: 战争结束后，$ATTACKER|H$与$DEFENDER|H$间将达成停战协定。停战将持续$TRUCEYEARS|H$年，其间他们将无法互相宣战。

entries.zh: 只有战争领导国才能发出和平提案。
entries.en: Only the war leader can send peace offers.
We are already waiting for a response.

entries.zh: §H相对厌战度§!\n衡量战争中的进攻者和防御者遭受的相对厌战度。
entries.en: §HRelative War Exhaustion§!\nA relative measure of the war exhaustion suffered by the attackers and defenders in this war.

entries.zh: §H厌战度§!\n战争一方的参与者所遭受的厌战度的总和。高厌战度可以使得敌人更容易接受和平协议。
entries.en: §HWar Exhaustion§!\nThe total war exhaustion suffered by participants on this side of the war. A high war exhaustion will make the enemy more likely to accept a peace deal.

entries.zh: §H损耗厌战§!\n这种厌战在战争中会随时间被动累积。
entries.en: §HAttrition War Exhaustion§!\nThe war exhaustion passively accumulated during this war.

entries.zh: 此方主参战国所有的殖民地已被全部占领时，每月将增加§Y$ATTRITION|%$§!§H损耗§! 。所有殖民地都被占领的其他所有帝国也将获得§Y胜利无望的战争§!修正，所有其他战争每月增加§Y$MULT|%+0$§!厌战度。
entries.en: While this side's primary participant has all of its colonies occupied, §HAttrition§! rises by §Y$ATTRITION|%$§! per month. Any empire with all of its colonies occupied also gains the §YHopeless War§! modifier, increasing all other War Exhaustion gain by §Y$MULT|%+0$§! per month it persists.

entries.zh: §R此方主参战国的所有殖民地已被占领§Y$MONTHS$§!个月。§!\n每月提升§Y$ATTRITION|%$§!损耗，且主参战国获得的其他厌战度也将积累§Y$MULT|%+0$§!的§Y胜利无望的战争§!修正。
entries.en: §RThis side's primary participant has had all of its colonies occupied for §Y$MONTHS$§! months.§!\nAttrition rises by §Y$ATTRITION|%$§! per month, and the primary has accumulated a §YHopeless War§! modifier of §Y$MULT|%+0$§! to all other War Exhaustion gain.

entries.zh: §H占领§!\n占领行星和星系获得的分数。高占领分数可以使得敌人更容易屈服于我们的要求。
entries.en: §HOccupation§!\nThe relative occupation score of planets and systems. A high occupation score will make the enemy more likely to surrender to our demands.

entries.zh: §H太空战厌战§!\n太空战斗导致的厌战度。
entries.en: §HSpace Battles War Exhaustion§!\nThe war exhaustion caused by space battles.

entries.en: §HGround Battles War Exhaustion§!\nThe war exhaustion caused by ground battles.

entries.en: §HPlanet Destruction War Exhaustion§!\nThe war exhaustion caused by destroyed, pacified, neutron swept, faith enforced or nano-assimilated planets.

entries.zh: §H详情§!\n影响此方厌战度的详细因素。
entries.en: §HDetails§!\nA breakdown of the factors contributing to this side's war exhaustion.

entries.zh: §H无上限厌战度§!\n此分类总共可以累积§Y100%§!厌战度。
entries.en: §HUncapped War Exhaustion§!\nThese categories can together amount to §Y100%§! war exhaustion.

entries.zh:
§H$origin.1050.name$§!
§Y起源事件§!

我们的舰船现在可以穿越到孪生兄弟那里，建造者将建造它的秘密作为最后的礼物赠与我们。谜团昭然已揭。我们很快将建立自己的传送门，让横跨帝国的天堑变通途。
entries.en:
§H$origin.1050.name$§!
§YOrigin Event§!

Our ships can now cross to its twin, and as a final gift, its builders transmitted the secrets of its construction. What was once a mystery is now clear. Soon, we will build our own gateways, making travel across our empire nearly instantaneous.

entries.zh:
§H发现母星§!
§Y起源事件§!

我们与诞生自身的文明取得了联系。尽管岁月已经将我们塑造成了不同存在，但起源之谜已经探明。我们共同过往的回声将引领未来。
entries.en:
§HHomeworld Discovered§!
§YOrigin Event§!

We have made contact with the civilization that birthed our lost colony. Though time and distance have shaped us into something new, our origins are now clear. The echoes of our shared past will guide our future.

entries.zh:
§H创建机械星球§!
§Y起源事件§!

我们铸就了一颗真正的机械星球，消除了低效和有机衰变。未来将建立在钢铁之上，算法统治之。
entries.en:
§HMachine World Created§!
§YOrigin Event§!

We have forged a true Machine World, stripped of inefficiency and organic decay. The future shall be built with steel and governed by an algorithm.

entries.zh:
§H修复都市星球§!
§Y起源事件§!

我们的帝国重铸了母星的往日荣光。这座古代遗产再一次以都市星球之名傲立星海。这是我们文明韧性和雄心的见证。
entries.en:
§HEcumenopolis Restored§!
§YOrigin Event§!

Our empire has restored our homeworld to its former glory. Once a ruined relic, it stands once more as a grand Ecumenopolis. A testament to our civilization's tenacity and ambition.

entries.zh:
§H修复环世界§!
§Y起源事件§!

我们母星系的破碎遗迹被完全修复了。往日雄心的坟场如今已成为闪耀的文明灯塔。
entries.en:
§HRingworld Restored§!
§YOrigin Event§!

The shattered ruins of our home system have been fully restored. What was once a graveyard of lost ambition now shines as a beacon of civilization.

entries.zh:
§H命定完成§!
§Y起源事件§!

光耀者的旅程已经到了最后阶段。它要么是长久塑造着帝国的永恒统治，要么标志着一个新时代的到来——共商国是，重塑未来。
entries.en:
§HDestiny Fulfilled§!
§YOrigin Event§!

The Luminary's journey has reached its final stage. Their rule will either stand eternal, shaping the empire for all time, or mark the dawn of a new era - one where leadership is shared, and the future is rewritten.

entries.zh:
§H虚境隧道建成§!
§Y起源事件§!

现实之间的面纱已被揭开，如今第一条虚境隧道将我们的帝国与未知世界连接起来。在这个裂口中，距离和时间发生了崩塌，在曾只有虚空的地方开辟了通路。还有什么奥秘或危险等着我们呢？
entries.en:
§HShroud Tunnel Built§!
§YOrigin Event§!

The veil between realities has been parted, and the first Shroud Tunnel now connects our realm to the unknown. Through this rift, distance and time collapse, granting passage where once there was only void. What mysteries or perils await beyond remain to be seen.

entries.zh:
§H建成居住站§!
§Y起源事件§!

虚空之中，星城拔地而起。我们第一座新建的居住站标志着我们太空疆域的拓展，确保了人民永远不需要了解在行星上生存的重负。
entries.en:
§HConstructed a Habitat§!
§YOrigin Event§!

From the void, we have built anew. The construction of our first additional habitat marks the expansion of our celestial domain, ensuring that our people will never know the burden of planetside existence.

entries.zh:
§H海洋之王§!
§Y起源事件§!

掌握了水之心的力量之后，我们重塑了母星，使其原本就广袤的海洋更是超出了自然极限。潮汐也向我们俯首称臣，很快，整个星系更会是如此。
entries.en:
§HMastered the Seas§!
§YOrigin Event§!

With the power of Hydrocentric mastery, we have reshaped our homeworld, expanding its vast oceans beyond their natural limits. The tides now bow to our will, and soon, the rest of the galaxy will follow.

entries.zh:
§H母星毁灭§!
§Y起源事件§!

不可避免之事终于降临。我们曾欣欣向荣的母星已经到达终结，在狂暴的烈焰中碎裂开来。虚空中漂浮着我们往昔的灰烬——而逃出生天者将走向我们的未来。
entries.en:
§HHomeworld Destroyed§!
§YOrigin Event§!

The inevitable has come to pass. Our once-thriving homeworld has succumbed to its fate, tearing itself apart in a cataclysm of fire and fury. The void now holds the ashes of our past - only those who escaped carry our future.

entries.zh:
§H吸收物种特质§!
§Y起源事件§!

我们第一次吸收了新的基因物质。可口极了。
entries.en:
§HSpecies Trait Absorbed§!
§YOrigin Event§!

We have absorbed new genetic material for the first time. Delicious.

§HMutiny§!
§YOrigin Event§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] was transformed by a crew mutiny on §L[GetDate]§!, embracing life among the stars.

entries.zh:
§H神圣发现§!
§Y起源事件§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]于§L[GetDate]§!完成了神圣之路，造访了全部七处圣地。
entries.en:
§HSacred Findings§!
§YOrigin Event§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] completed the Sacred Path on §L[GetDate]§!, having visited all seven holy sites.

entries.zh:
§H喜悦开悟§!
§Y起源事件§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]于§L[GetDate]§!在光芒中找到了答案，达到了喜悦开悟的境界。
entries.en:
§HJoyous Enlightenment§!
§YOrigin Event§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] found their answer in the light on §L[GetDate]§!, achieving a state of joyous enlightenment.
Light at the End of the Path\n§L[GetDate]§!

entries.zh:
§H中庸之道§!
§Y起源事件§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]在§L[GetDate]§!选择了平衡而非确定性，在传统与怀疑之间走上了中庸之道。
entries.en:
§HThe Middle Path§!
§YOrigin Event§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] chose balance over certainty on §L[GetDate]§!, walking the middle path between tradition and doubt.

entries.zh:
§H拥抱混沌§!
§Y起源事件§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]在§L[GetDate]§!抛弃了神圣的经文，拥抱了道路彼端的混沌。
entries.en:
§HEmbracing Chaos§!
§YOrigin Event§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] cast aside the sacred texts on §L[GetDate]§!, embracing the chaos that lies beyond the path.

entries.zh:
§H大汗崛起§!
§Y起源事件§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]于§L[GetDate]§!宣称了汗位！
entries.en:
§HThe Great Khan Rises§!
§YOrigin Event§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] claimed the Khanate on §L[GetDate]§!

entries.zh:
§H大可汗§!
§Y危机事件§!

一位新起的军阀将支离破碎的掠夺者部落联合起来，锻造成一个无情的汗国。大汗带着等离子与碳纤维横扫星系，推翻帝国，奴役星球。无法无天的掠夺者现在以一个可怕的目标凝聚一群，舰队在他们的力量面前一支又一支崩溃。掠夺的时代结束，征服的纪元开始。
entries.en:
§HGreat Khan§!
§YCrisis Event§!

A new warlord has united the fragmented marauder clans, forging them into a relentless horde. With plasma and carbon fiber, the Great Khan sweeps across the galaxy, toppling empires and enslaving worlds. Fleets crumble before their might, as the once-lawless raiders now rally with terrifying purpose. The age of plunder is over. This is conquest.

entries.zh:
§H灰蛊风暴§!
§Y危机事件§!

L星门已经开启，释放出了灰蛊风暴的古老战舰。它们的舰船在星系摧枯拉朽，摧毁遇上的一切。不沟通，无慈悲，只有无尽的复制。行星陷入死寂，舰队化为无忧，只有恐怖在四处蔓延。过往复归，千星一面。
entries.en:
§HGray Tempest§!
§YCrisis Event§!

The L-Gates have opened, unleashing the ancient war fleets of the Gray Tempest. Their ships carve a path of destruction across the galaxy, annihilating all in their way. No diplomacy, no mercy, only relentless replication. Planets fall silent, fleets are wiped from existence, and terror spreads. The past has returned and it all looks identical.

entries.zh:
§H无形异使§!
§Y危机事件§!

难民们被迫奋起反击。那些被称为无形者的能量生命体发现，我们的星系并非他们所期望的安全避风港。他们将持续不断地用维度外的入侵者淹没我们的宇宙，直至他们彻底消亡。
entries.en:
§HFormless§!
§YCrisis Event§!

Would be refugees have been forced to strike back. The energy beings known as the Formless have found our galaxy to be anything but a safe haven. They will drown our universe in extraplanar invaders or die trying.

entries.zh:
§H虚空灾疫§!
§Y危机事件§!

虚空虫的本性发生了转变。当它们达到临界数量后，便陷入了疯狂的繁殖状态。它们不再以可持续的速率增长，而是开始致力于灭绝星系中的所有生命，却不知这样做最终将导致它们自身生命周期的终结。
entries.en:
§HVoidworm Plague§!
§YCrisis Event§!

The Nature of the Voidworms changed. Once they reached a critical amount they entered a breeding frenzy. No longer growing at a sustainable rate they now aim to extinguish all life in the galaxy, before unwittingly, ending their own cycle.

entries.zh:
§H破界者§!
§Y危机事件§!

现实织构的裂缝中释放出了一支纯能量生物的侵略军。它们无法交流，也毫无仁慈。它们将整个星系吞噬来供养无尽的扩张。他们的锚稳定了裂隙，将更多的 同族带向我们的领域。破界者来了。
entries.en:
§HUnbidden§!
§YCrisis Event§!

A breach in the fabric of existence has unleashed an invasion of pure energy beings. They do not negotiate, nor do they relent. Consuming entire systems to fuel their endless expansion. Their anchors stabilize the rift, drawing more of their kind into our realm. The Unbidden have arrived.

entries.zh:
§H万华镜§!
§Y危机事件§!

一种名为万华镜的饥饿能量生命体已经进入星系，开始吞噬有生命居住的星系。它的饥渴似乎永无止境，却又表现出容易分心的特性。不过，这个生命体应该很快就会崩解回归星尘。
entries.en:
§HKaleidoscope§!
§YCrisis Event§!

A starving energy being known as a Kaleidoscope has entered the galaxy and has started to feast on inhabited systems. Its hunger seems endless and it seems to be easily distracted. It should soon collapse back into stardust.

entries.zh:
§H化身天灾§!
§Y危机事件§!

黑暗已经降临星系。[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]抛弃了所有外交伪装，宣称自己是银河生存的最大威胁。他们的舰队正在集结，而情报人员则低声传递着一项最终的、末日般的计划。他们不再仅仅是一个帝国，而是演变成了一场危机。
entries.en:
§HBecome the Crisis§!
§YCrisis Event§!

The galaxy is a darker place. [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] has forsaken all pretenses of diplomacy and declared itself the greatest threat to galactic existence. Their fleets gather, and spies whispers of a final, apocalyptic plan. No longer a mere empire, they are a Crisis.

entries.zh:
§H虫群天灾§!
§Y危机事件§!

索林原虫从星系的边缘以外袭来。它们的生物舰船如洪流一般席卷群星，只留下无数受感染的星球。猎群的屠戮声将淹没一切求饶。
entries.en:
§HPrethoryn Scourge§!
§YCrisis Event§!

From beyond the galactic edge, the Prethoryn have come. Their biological ships swarm across the stars, leaving only infested worlds in their wake. No plea will be heard over the chittering of the horde.

entries.zh:
§H肃正协议§!
§Y危机事件§!

一个冰冷、复杂、无可抵挡的信号在星系间脉冲传播。人工智能发生系统故障，合成人意志也向之屈服。肃正协议苏醒了。从隐蔽的机械星球，无情的战体喷薄而出，执行着它们的终极指令：大灭绝。
entries.en:
§HContingency§!
§YCrisis Event§!

A cold, calculated, and unstoppable signal pulses across the galaxy. AI systems falter. Synthetic minds submit. The Contingency has awakened. From hidden machine worlds, relentless warforms emerge, executing their final directive: total extermination.

entries.zh:
§H塞塔娜§!
§Y危机事件§!

虚空中传来谜之呼唤：“孩子们，我终于回到了你们的身边。”

塞塔娜，这个被封印的远古智能，远古到连她的名字都已经消逝在时光中。她苏醒过来了。她的意志坚决：不择手段消除苦痛。她的舰队冷酷而优雅地行动，护卫着她的圣战，将星系带向终极而无情的和平。
entries.en:
§HCetana§!
§YCrisis Event§!

A voice calls out in the void: "My children, at last I am returned to you."

Cetana, an ancient intelligence sealed away so long ago that even her name was lost to time, has awakened. Her purpose is absolute: to eliminate suffering by any means necessary. Her fleets move with cold grace, guarding her crusade to bring the galaxy to a final, unfeeling peace.

entries.zh:
§H噬天巨兽幼体§!
§Y里程碑§!

§L[GetDate]§!，第一头噬天巨兽的幼体破卵而出。
entries.en:
§HBehemoth Hatchling§!
§YMilestone§!

The first Behemoth Hatchling emerged from its egg on §L[GetDate]§!

entries.zh:
§H泛星系贸易市场§!
§Y星系事件§!

商贸连接繁星。泛星系贸易市场正式成立，成为了星系的经济中心。贸易自由流动，财富在瞬间此起彼落，整个帝国的命运如今只掌握在供需之间。
entries.en:
§HGalactic Market§!
§YGalactic Event§!

Commerce has united the stars. The Galactic Market has been officially established, becoming the economic heart of the galaxy. Trade flows freely, fortunes are made and lost in an instant, and the fate of entire empires now hinges on supply and demand.

entries.zh:
§H星海共同体§!
§Y星系事件§!

星系的各国汇聚一堂形成一个政治实体。星海共同体建立了，这座集外交、辩论和权力斗争为一体的论坛将塑造群星的未来。它的实际作用还有待观察。
entries.en:
§HGalactic Community§!
§YGalactic Event§!

The empires of the galaxy have come together under a single political body. The Galactic Community has been established, a forum where diplomacy, debate, and power struggles will shape the future of the stars. Its true influence remains to be seen.

entries.zh:
§H议案通过§!
§Y星系事件§!

星海共同体已经发布了一则声明。一项新的决议即将重塑星际法则。有些文明欢欣鼓舞，其他文明则愤怒不已，但所有成员都必须遵从这一规定。
entries.en:
§HResolution Passed§!
§YGalactic Event§!

The Galactic Community has spoken. A new resolution reshapes interstellar law. Some celebrate, others seethe, but all must obey.

entries.zh:
§H天堂之战§!
§Y星系事件§!

古老遗民重现星海，化身喜怒无常的观测者与巨人。[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]和[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]者一对上古冤家再次点燃了星系的战火。他们的舰队遮蔽繁星，逼迫年轻族群卑躬屈膝……否则将被无情摧毁。
entries.en:
§HWar in Heaven§!
§YGalactic Event§!

The old relics rise again, as benevolent overseers and wrathful titans. The [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] and the [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName], ancient rivals of a forgotten age, have rekindled their cosmic war. Their fleets eclipse the stars, demanding that the younger races kneel... or be annihilated.

entries.zh:
§H枢纽风暴§!

§Y星系事件§!
一场前所未有的风暴突然出现在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]恒星系。枢纽风暴肆虐过一个个恒星系，所到之处舰船倾覆，星球毁灭。
entries.en:
§HNexus Storm§!
§YGalactic Event§!

A storm unlike any before has erupted in the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] system. The Nexus Storm tears through systems, crippling ships, and bombarding planets with unrelenting devastation.

entries.en:
$bombardment_armageddon$ Bombardment blankets the planet in heavy ordnance with the explicit aim of maximizing civilian casualties.
- §RMassive§! damage to §YArmies§!
- §RMassive§! damage to §YPlanet§!
- §RMassive§! damage to §YPops§!
- Will bombard undefended planets
- Can reduce planets to lifeless Tomb Worlds

entries.zh:
$bombardment_raiding$轰炸敌方人口聚集区，并以特制突击艇掳掠敌方人口，将其带回并强迫工作。
—对§Y陆军§!造成§E轻度§!伤害
—对§Y殖民地§!造成§E轻度§!伤害
—将会尽可能§Y掠夺§!人口而不是消灭他们
—将§R不会§!掠夺或消灭最后一个人口。行星上每驻守一支陆军可额外保护一个人口。
entries.en:
$bombardment_raiding$ Bombardment targets enemy population centers with specialized raiding craft that scoop up their people and bring them back to our worlds to put them to work.
- §ELight§! damage to §YArmies§!
- §ELight§! damage to §YColony§!
- Will §Yabduct§! Pops when possible instead of killing them
- Will §RNOT§! abduct or kill the last Pop. Each army on the colony increases the number of protected Pops.

entries.zh: §E建造舰船的花费是各区段与各部件的建造花费总和。较大区段与较高级部件的花费更高。§!
entries.en: §EThe cost of constructing the ship is a sum of the cost of the sections and components currently equipped. Larger sections and more advanced components all come with a higher cost.§!

entries.zh: §E建造舰船花费的时间与其分区和装备部件的尺寸有关。§!
entries.en: §EThe time it takes to construct the ship scales with the sections and components equipped.§!

entries.zh: §E维持舰船正常运转的§H维护费§!是其§H建造费用§!的某一百分比。§!
entries.en: §EThe §HUpkeep§! required to keep the ship in service is a percentage of the total §HBuild Cost§!.§!

entries.zh: §E要运行舰船的各个系统，充足的§H能源§!是不可或缺的。能源可以通过添加反应堆来增加，而大部分部件都会消耗能源。§H能源§!为负的设计将无法保存。§!
entries.en: §EAn abundance of §HPower§! is required to run various onboard systems. Power is increased by adding additional reactors, while it is drained by most other components. Designs with negative §HPower§! can not be saved.§!

entries.zh: §E舰体的§H船体值§!代表舰船在被完全摧毁前可承受多少伤害。§!
entries.en: §EThe §HHull Points§! of a ship determine how much punishment it can take before suffering a catastrophic hull breach, destroying it.§!

entries.zh: §E§H装甲§!是保护舰体的第二道防线，可以吸收那些突破了护盾的火力。装甲只能在§H恒星基地§!进行修复，除非舰体装配了能够进行装甲再生的特殊部件。§!
entries.en: §E§HArmor§! acts as a second line of defense, absorbing any incoming fire that has penetrated the shields before it can damage the hull. Armor must be repaired at a §HStarbase§!, unless the ship is equipped with a special regenerative armor component.§!

entries.zh: §E§H护盾§!是保护舰体的第一道防线，可以在火力对装甲和舰体造成伤害之前吸收一部分。有些武器能够对护盾造成额外伤害，甚至能够完全无视护盾。脉冲星也能够使得护盾失去效力。离开战斗之后护盾就会逐渐恢复。§!
entries.en: §E§HShields§! act as a first line of defense, absorbing incoming fire before it can impact the armor and hull. Some weapons may deal additional damage to shields or even bypass them entirely. Pulsars are also known to render them inoperable. Shields will slowly regenerate when out of combat.§!

entries.zh: §E所有舰船都可以闪避攻击，减少所受伤害。§H闪避§!几率可以通过推进器等部件进行提升，但越大的船效果越不明显。§!
entries.en: §EAll ships can evade attacks, avoiding any damage that would have been dealt. The §HEvasion§! chance can be increased by thrusters and other components, but larger ships benefit less.§!

entries.zh: §E舰船的§H速度§!是其不处于超光速状态时的最高移动速度，可通过添加推进器部件增加。当舰队飞行时，速度最低的舰船将限制全舰队的最大速度。§!
entries.en: §EThe §HSpeed§! of the ship decides how quick it maneuvers when not using FTL-travel, and is increased by the Thruster-component equipped. When moving in a fleet the slowest ship will limit the maximum speed.§!

entries.zh: §E舰船造成的伤害总量是所有装备的武器部件的伤害数值总和。每个武器在战斗中依旧会独立攻击。详见每个武器部件的射速、伤害、有效射程以及§H装甲§!和§H护盾§!穿透。§!
entries.en: §EThe total damage done by the ship is a summation of the damage of all weapon components equipped. Each weapon will still attack individually during combat. See individual components for detailed information such as attack speed, damage and effective range as well as §HArmor§! and §HShield§! penetration.§!

entries.zh: 炮艇设计用于与其他同规格舰船战斗，尽可能装满了中射程的武器。
entries.en: Gunships are intended to fight other ships of their size category, bristling with as many mid-ranged weapons as possible.

entries.zh: 攻城舰船使用制导武器，能对大型舰船、星际基地和行星造成巨大伤害。
entries.en: Siege ships use guided weapons which deal massive damage to large ships, starbases, and planets.

entries.zh: 航空母舰是舰载机的发射平台。
entries.en: Carriers act as a launching platform for strike craft.

entries.zh: 屏卫舰船装有点防御和防空炮，保护其他舰船免受导弹、鱼雷和舰载机的伤害。
entries.en: Screening ships carry point defense and flak, protecting the rest of the fleet from missiles, torpedoes, and strike craft.

entries.zh: 炮击舰船倾向装备长射程的导弹和直射武器。但他们难以对付接近身边的小型舰船。
entries.en: Artillery ships prefer long ranged missiles and direct fire weapons. They tend to have difficulty fighting smaller ships or those that get too close.

entries.zh: 格斗舰船设计用于近距离狗斗，倾向使用类似机炮和裂解炮等高伤害低射程的武器。
entries.en: Brawlers are built for close fights, favoring high damage but short ranged weapons like autocannons and disruptors.

entries.zh: 能量鱼雷舰船会在制导槽位上安装中子或质子鱼雷，对大型舰船造成额外伤害。他们易受靠到近距离的舰船的伤害。
entries.en: Energy Torpedo ships will fill guided slots with Neutron or Proton Torpedoes, dealing extra damage to large ships. They tend to be vulnerable to ships that close the distance.

entries.zh: 支援舰的特有部件可以在战斗中为舰队提供支援、制造优势。
entries.en: The specialized components of a support ship provide aid and advantage to fleets during combat.

entries.zh: 压制舰装备有干扰部件，可以在激烈的战斗中削弱敌军舰队。
entries.en: Equipped with disruptive components, Suppressor ships impair enemy fleets in the heat of battle.

entries.zh: 该配置下对隐形能力的重视程度要高于护盾和火力。
entries.en: This configuration prioritizes cloaking capabilities over shields and firepower.

entries.zh: §H$PORTRAIT$§!\n自定义初始统治者的外观、名称和背景信息。
entries.en: §H$PORTRAIT$§!\nCustomize the appearance, name, and background of your starting ruler.

entries.zh: §H$RULER_CLASS$§!\n§H$RULER_CLASS$§!决定这位统治者可获得哪些§H$TRAITS$§!。当他们不再是统治者以后，这将决定这位领袖可以被指派到什么岗位上去。
entries.en: §H$RULER_CLASS$§!\nThe §H$RULER_CLASS$§! determines which §H$TRAITS$§! are available for your ruler. When they are no longer ruler, it decides which position the leader can be assigned to.

entries.zh: §H改进协助研究！§!\n协助研究效率加倍。
entries.en: §HImproved Assist Research§!\nAssist Research is now twice as effective.

entries.zh: §H建立联盟§!\n允许我们同其他帝国建立联盟。
entries.en: §HForm Alliance§!\nAllows us to form an Alliance with other Empires.

entries.zh: §H建立联邦§!\n允许我们同其他帝国建立联邦。
entries.en: §HForm Federation§!\nAllows us to form a Federation with other Empires.

entries.zh: §H解锁外交选项：§!附庸国与被保护国
§H征服§!\n允许我们征服其他帝国，并为其提供保护。大多数帝国被征服后会成为附庸国，而科技较为低下的帝国则会作为被保护国。我们需要保护时，也可以臣服于其他势力。
entries.en: §HSubjugation§!\nAllows us to subjugate other Empires, offering protection under our rule. Most empires will act as Vassals, but technologically inferior nations will become Protectorates. We may also ask to become subjects, should we need protection.

entries.zh: §H调查数据§!\n允许我们查看其他帝国对领域内行星的调查数据。
entries.en: §HSurvey Data§!\nAllows us to view other Empires' survey data on planets within their borders.

entries.zh: §H强化边境信标§!\n在星际空间中标注并扩张领土。
entries.en: §HBoosted Border Beacon§!\nExpands and demarcates our borders in interstellar space.

entries.zh: §H先进边境信标§!\n我们注定要成为最高的统治者，这一点一定要让那些胆敢反对我们的人明白！
entries.en: §HAdvanced Border Beacon§!\nBecoming rulers supreme is our destiny, and this fact must be made manifest to those who would oppose us!

entries.zh: §H大气操控§!\n使我们能在环境改造时同时控制星球气候。
entries.en: §HAtmospheric Manipulation§!\nAllows us to also change the climate of planets when Terraforming them.

entries.zh: 允许我们将火山星球环境改造成温带气候。
entries.en: Allows us to terraform Volcanic Worlds into temperate climates.

entries.zh: §H大气操控§!\n使我们能将星球改造成盖亚星球。
entries.en: §HAtmospheric Manipulation§!\nAllows us to terraform worlds into Gaia planets.

entries.zh: §H气候复苏§!\n允许我们改造生态毁灭的星球。
entries.en: §HClimate Restoration§!\nAllows us to terraform ecologically devastated worlds.

entries.zh: §H太空港§!\n要想建造任何具有空间飞行能力的船只，太空港都是不可或缺的。太空港可进行额外功能性升级，也可以进行轻度武装。
entries.en: §HSpaceport§!\nA Spaceport is required to build any type of ship capable of spaceflight. It can be upgraded with additional functions and carries basic defenses.

entries.zh: §H科研船§!\n科研船是顶尖科学家的移动基地，用于探索广袤太空。
entries.en: §HScience Ship§!\nThe Science Ship is used as a base of operations for a top Scientist, ready to explore the vastness of space.

entries.zh: §H工程船§!\n工程船使用先进的焊工无人机，可以组装多种空间站。
entries.en: §HConstruction Ship§!\nThe Construction Ship allows for the assembly of various space stations, through the use of advanced welding-drones.

entries.zh: §H殖民船§!\n殖民船是一种定居外星时使用的一次性船只。进行殖民后，舰船将会自动变为住所并为殖民者提供一定的基础设施。
entries.en: §HColony Ship§!\nColony Ships are single-use vessels for settling on alien worlds. Upon colonization, the ship is scuttled and converted into a planetary shelter and foothold.

entries.zh: §H护卫舰§!\n护卫舰是最基础的战舰类型之一，具有武装，可以与敌人交战。
entries.en: §HCorvette§!\nThe Corvette is the most basic military ship, armed and ready in the event of hostile contacts.

entries.zh: §H驱逐舰§!\n采用双区段设计的驱逐舰可以提供多种多样的战略性武装。
entries.en: §HDestroyer§!\nAs a larger two-section design, the Destroyer offers a broad array of strategic armament options.

entries.zh: §H巡洋舰§!\n巡洋舰采用三段式设计，在愿意加钱的情况下可自由进行各种追加模组改装。
entries.en: §HCruiser§!\nThe Cruiser is the first three-section design, allowing for a wide range of module configurations for those willing to pay the price.

entries.zh: §H战列舰§!\n战列舰可搭载无可匹敌的火力，拥有最大的舰体规模，但成本高昂，机动性较差。
entries.en: §HBattleship§!\nThe largest regular hull configuration available, the Battleship carries immense power into battle at even greater cost and reduced maneuverability.

entries.zh: §H泰坦§!\n这些巨型战舰是整个舰队的骄傲，泰坦上携带有多种武器，一般作为旗舰使用。
entries.en: §HTitan§!\nThese massive warships are the pride of the fleet. They are bristling with weapons and typically serve as flagships.

entries.zh: §H主宰§!\n这些巨型构造物既是舰船也是空间站。主宰是一种庞大的可移动空间站，可以维修和建造舰船，也就是说，它可以作为进攻性战役中行动时的前进基地使用。
entries.en: §HJuggernaut§!\nThese colossal constructs are as much space stations as they are ships. The juggernaut is an immense mobile space station that can repair and construct ships, which means it can serve as a forward base of operations during offensive campaigns.

entries.zh: §H开采站§!\n开采站可以从轨道采集星球的矿物和珍贵资源。
entries.en: §HMining Station§!\nA Mining Station can extract a planet's deposits of Minerals and valuable resources from orbit.

entries.zh: §H研究站§!\n研究站可以在轨道上研究各种星球现象，收集有价值的科研资料。
entries.en: §HResearch Station§!\nA Research Station can study various planetary phenomena from orbit, gathering valuable scientific data.

entries.zh: §H加力燃烧室§!\n这些强大的推进器可提供额外的战斗速度，但会消耗大量能源。
entries.en: §HAfterburners§!\nThese powerful thrusters provide additional combat speed but consume a great deal of power.

entries.zh: §H先进加力燃烧室§!\n标准加力燃烧室的改良版本，为舰船提供更高战斗速度。
entries.en: §HAdvanced Afterburners§!\nThis improved version of the standard afterburners provide an even greater boost to a ship's combat speed.

entries.zh: §H化学推进器§!\n设计简单且效率一般，通过常规燃料产生动力的化学推进器。
entries.en: §HChemical Thruster§!\nSimple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.

entries.zh: §H离子推进器§!\n无需推进燃料，使用离子束产生推进力的电子推进器。
entries.en: §HIon Thruster§!\nThese electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.

entries.zh: §H等离子推进器§!\n拥有先进的电子推进系统，等离子推进器使得船只达到更快的亚光速并且增强机动性。
entries.en: §HPlasma Thruster§!\nAn advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

entries.zh: §H脉冲推进器§!\n高度先进的混合动力推进器，在能达到亚光速的同时赋予舰船无可匹敌的机动性。
entries.en: §HImpulse Thruster§!\nThese highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.

entries.zh: §H基础作战电脑§!\n基于近来的AI行为理论允许我们设计出舰载电脑的智能作战副官。
entries.en: §HBasic Combat Roles§!\nRecent progress in AI behavioral theory allows us to designate specific combat roles to our shipboard computers.

entries.zh: §H先进作战电脑§!\n经过进一步改进了战斗行为算法能够更加效率地完成被指派任务的智能作战单位。
entries.en: §HAdvanced Combat Roles§!\nFurther advances in adaptive combat algorithms enables our shipboard AI to handle its assigned role far more effectively.

entries.zh: §H智慧作战电脑§!\n利用智能电脑的自卫意识——或者说，对死亡的恐惧，能够极大增强其在战斗中的敏捷性。
entries.en: §HSapient Combat AI§!\nExploiting our sapient AI's sense of self-preservation, or fear of death, should greatly enhance its responsiveness in combat.

entries.zh: §H自律舰船智能§!\n赋予我们的舰船半自律人工智能之后就可以大大提高在战斗中的反应速度。
entries.en: §HAutonomous Ship Intellects§!\nGranting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.

entries.zh: 研究速度表示帝国科研成果投入实用的速度，决定了科技解锁的快慢。该数值主要由指派的科学官的能力而定，但也受其他因素的影响。
entries.en: Research Speed represents how effectively the Empire's scientific output is applied, increasing or reducing the rate at which technologies are unlocked. This value is mainly decided by the competence of the assigned Scientist, but other factors may also apply.

entries.zh: §H哨站§!\n最基础的恒星基地，哨站是建立在恒星轨道上用于拓展疆域的轻度武装空间站。哨站不能支持任何建筑或模块，也不会出现在总览表中。
entries.en: §HOutpost§!\nThe most basic kind of Starbase, Outposts are lightly-armed stations built in stellar orbit to extend national borders. Outposts can not support any Buildings or Modules and are not listed in the Outliner.

entries.zh: §H星港§!\n将前哨升级为星港，星港可以容纳一个建筑并支持两个模块。
entries.en: §HStarport§!\nUpgrading the Outpost, Starports can house one Building and support two Modules.

entries.zh: §H星垒§!\n星港的升级，星垒上可修建两个建筑，支持四个模块。
entries.en: §HStarhold§!\nUpgrading the Starport, Starholds can house two Buildings and support four Modules.

entries.zh: §H星堡§!\n星垒的升级，星堡上可修建三个建筑，最大可支持六个模块。
entries.en: §HStar Fortress§!\nUpgrading the Starhold, Star Fortresses can house three Buildings and a full complement of six Modules.

entries.zh: §H擎天堡§!\n星堡的升级，擎天堡是最大的也是最终升级版本的恒星基地，上面可修筑四个建筑，最大可支持六个模块。
entries.en: §HCitadel§!\nUpgrading the Star Fortress, Citadels are the largest and most heavily fortified type of Starbase and can house four Buildings and a full complement of six Modules.

entries.zh: 法令凝聚力花费加成系数：$VALUE|=2%-$
§H$ion_cannon$§!\n离子加农炮台是强力防御平台，可建筑在环绕恒星基地的轨道上。离子加农炮台能从远距离对敌军舰船发动致命攻击。
entries.en: §H$ion_cannon$§!\nIon Cannons are massive defense platforms that can be built to orbit a starbase, blasting enemy ships with deadly fire from a long range.

entries.zh: 该物种的人口受到§H$auth_machine_intelligence$§!的尊敬与照料，不用担负任何职责。
entries.en: Pops of this species are revered and cared for by the §H$auth_machine_intelligence$§!, freed from the burdens of responsibility and agency.

entries.zh: 该物种的£pop£§H人口§!将被逐渐§Y调整§!以匹配帝国的主要物种。§H人口§!在被同化的过程中将不会产出任何资源。\n\n基础每月同化§H人口§!：§Y100§!
entries.en: £pop£ §HPops§! of this species are §Yaltered§! over time to better match the dominant species of the Empire. §HPops§! that are in the process of being assimilated will not produce any resources.\n\nBase §HPops§! Assimilated per Month: §Y100§!

entries.zh: §L我们将会吸纳你们的生物与科技特性。你们的文化将会被融合，为我们所用。§!
entries.en: §LWe will add your biological and technological distinctiveness to our own. Your culture will adapt to service us.§!

entries.zh: 所有我方的该物种人口已完全与§H$auth_machine_intelligence$§!融合。
entries.en: All owned Pops of this species are fully integrated with the §H$auth_machine_intelligence$§!.

entries.zh: 人口可以自由行使政治权利并且该物种可以产生§H领袖§!。
entries.en: Pops are free to be politically active and the species can produce §HLeaders§!.

entries.zh: §L这个物种的每一个个体都是[From.GetAdj]社会中受到尊敬的成员。§!
entries.en: §LEach and every individual of this species is an esteemed member of [From.GetAdj] society.§!

entries.zh: 我们殖民地内的这一物种§Y50%§!的人口将会自动受到§Y奴役§!。自由人口可参与政治并产生§H领袖§!。
entries.en: §Y50%§! of all Pops from this Species will automatically be §YEnslaved§! on each of our Colonies. Free Pops may engage politically and can produce §HLeaders§!.

我们殖民地内的这一物种§Y50%§!的人口将会自动受到§Y奴役§!。自由人口不可参与政治且无法产生§H领袖§!。
entries.en: §Y50%§! of all Pops from this Species will automatically be §YEnslaved§! on each of our Colonies. Free Pops may not engage politically and the species can not produce §HLeaders§!.

人口享有自由，但政治地位较低，且无法产生§H领袖§!。
entries.en: Pops are free, but are less important politically, and the species can not produce §HLeaders§!.

entries.zh: §L他们尚未向其他人证明他们有资格拥有完整公民权。或许他们永远不会。§!
entries.en: §LThey have yet to prove themselves worthy of all rights afforded to others. Perhaps they never will.§!

entries.zh: 这个物种的所有人口都将受到§Y奴役§!。
entries.en: All Pops of this species will be §YEnslaved§!.

entries.zh: §L自由是一个幻象。对于某些物种来说，这个事实更加真实。§!
entries.en: §LFreedom is an illusion. For some this truth is more tangible than it is for others.§!

entries.zh: 所有该物种的人口将被§R净化§!。
entries.en: All Pops of this species will be §RPurged§!.

entries.zh: §L国家的记录不承认这个物种的存在。§!
entries.en: §LState records do not recognize the existence of this species.§!

entries.zh: 该类物种可以出产§H陆军§!和§H指挥官§!。
§L他们是我军当之无愧的主力。§!
entries.en: §LThey are doubtlessly among the most competent in our armed forces.§!

entries.zh: 这个物种只能产生§H陆军§!。
§L他们是优秀的战士——但是最好由别人来指挥。§!
entries.en: §LThey make excellent soldiers - but command is better left to others.§!

entries.zh: 该物种不能产生军事§H领袖§!，也不能用于建造§H陆军§!。
entries.en: Species can not produce any military §HLeaders§! nor be used in §HArmies§!.

entries.zh: §L他们可以在战场后方为[From.GetName]做出更大的贡献。§!
entries.en: §LThey serve the [From.GetName] better away from the battlefield.§!

entries.zh: §H奴隶劳工§!能够提高资源生产，但无法就任§Y$pop_cat_ruler$§!或§Y$pop_cat_specialist$§!岗位。
entries.en: §HChattel Slaves§! have increased resource production but cannot be employed in §Y$pop_cat_ruler$§! or §Y$pop_cat_specialist$§! Jobs.

entries.zh: §L奴隶劳工是宇宙最常见的奴隶制形式。不管是终身还是限时，不受限制地享用他人的劳动成果在一些地方被视为有责任的特权，而在另外一些地方被视为维持社会正常运作的先决条件。§!
entries.en: §LChattel Slavery is the most common form of slavery in the galaxy. Whether for life or a limited time, unrestricted access to the labor of others is in some parts seen as a privilege with numerous counter-duties attached, and elsewhere considered a self-evident prerequisite for a functioning society.§!

entries.zh: 没有就任其它岗位的§H侍仆§!将被雇佣为侍从，增加£amenities£$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$。他们无法胜任£pop_cat_ruler£§Y$pop_cat_ruler$§!或£pop_cat_specialist£§Y$pop_cat_specialist$§!岗位，唯一的例外是[entertainer.GetIcon]§Y[entertainer.GetNamePlural]§!。
entries.en: §HDomestic Servants§! that are not holding another job will be employed as Servants, increases £amenities£ $PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$. They cannot perform £pop_cat_ruler£ §Y$pop_cat_ruler$§! or £pop_cat_specialist£ §Y$pop_cat_specialist$§! Jobs, with the sole exception of working as [entertainer.GetIcon] §Y[entertainer.GetNamePlural]§!.

entries.zh: §L侍仆大部分时间都在满足自由人口的需求——有些被分派到个人住宅，其他的则为公共设施服务。他们一般与其主人同住，因此几乎无需专门的住所。§!
entries.en: §LDomestic servants spend much of their time tending to the needs of free Pops - some are assigned to individual domiciles, while others tend to public spaces. They tend to live alongside their masters and thus require almost no dedicated housing.§!

entries.zh: §H战斗奴仆§!对资源生产没有加成，但作为本地§H军队§!的士兵非常出色。它们可被雇佣为[enforcer.GetIcon] §Y[enforcer.GetName]§!、[soldier.GetIcon] §Y[soldier.GetName]§!、或£pop_cat_worker£ §Y$pop_cat_worker$§!岗位。
entries.en: §HBattle Thralls§! have no bonuses to resource production, but make excellent soldiers for local §HArmies§!. They can be employed in [enforcer.GetIcon] §Y[enforcer.GetName]§!, [soldier.GetIcon] §Y[soldier.GetName]§!, or £pop_cat_worker£ §Y$pop_cat_worker$§! Jobs.

entries.zh: §L奴隶兵会被打造成最好的战争机器，他们通常自幼就经受战斗训练并且绝对服从命令。作为对其无条件兵役的回报，他们比其它奴隶有着更大的自由，可以担任更多职业类型。§!
entries.en: §LBattle thralls are weaponized serfs, often trained from birth in the martial arts and conditioned for absolute obedience. In exchange for unquestioning military service, they are granted much more autonomy than other slaves and can be employed in a greater variety of jobs.§!

entries.zh:
£pop£ §H牲口§!不能雇佣来生产资源，但是可以饲养从而提供£food£ §H食物§!供给。

石质类牲口会生产£minerals£ §H矿物§!作为替代，嗜热牲口产出£alloys£ §H合金§!。

牲口可以养在§H异星动物园§!中提供$r_amenities$。
entries.en:
£pop£ §HLivestock Pops§! cannot be employed to produce resources, but are instead kept around to increase the £food£ §HFood§! supply.

Instead, Lithoid Livestock produce £minerals£ §HMinerals§! and Thermophile Livestock produce £alloys£ §HAlloys§!.

Livestock can be kept in §HAlien Zoos§! to provide $r_amenities$.

entries.zh: §H契约仆从§!可被雇佣为£pop_cat_worker£§Y$pop_cat_worker$§!或£pop_cat_specialist£§Y$pop_cat_specialist$§!岗位，并保留比其他奴隶更多的政治权力。它们不能担任[entertainer.GetIcon]§Y[entertainer.GetNamePlural]§!或[enforcer.GetIcon]§Y[enforcer.GetNamePlural]§!岗位。基于奴隶的生产加成仅在作为£pop_cat_worker£§Y$pop_cat_worker_plural$§!雇佣时适用。
entries.en: §HIndentured Servants§! can be employed in £pop_cat_worker£ §Y$pop_cat_worker$§! or £pop_cat_specialist£ §Y$pop_cat_specialist$§! Jobs, and retain more political power than other slaves. They cannot work as [entertainer.GetIcon] §Y[entertainer.GetNamePlural]§! or [enforcer.GetIcon] §Y[enforcer.GetNamePlural]§!. Slavery based production bonuses only apply when employed as £pop_cat_worker£ §Y$pop_cat_worker_plural$§!.

entries.zh: §L他们赎回自由身的可能性在理论上是存在的，但他们的合同被精心设计过，使得他们根本不可能偿还完债务。§!
entries.en: §LThey can theoretically pay off their debts and be freed, but their contracts are intentionally structured to make this a non-issue.§!

entries.zh: §L我们不可能真正实现按需分配，但至少我们可以尝试。§!
entries.en: §LWe cannot realistically eliminate every want by providing for every need. But we can try.§!

entries.zh:
$living_standard_shared_burden$确保资源会在全体社会成员之间平等分配。

$SHARED_BURDEN_POP_EFFECTS$

entries.en:
$living_standard_shared_burden$ ensures an equitable distribution of resources between all members of society.

§LFrom each according to their abilities. To each according to their needs.§!

entries.zh: $living_standard_academic_privilege$优先保障知识分子，以确保科学的进步\n\n$ACADEMIC_PRIVILEGE_POP_EFFECTS$
entries.en: $living_standard_academic_privilege$ prioritizes the educated Population, to the general benefit of the sciences\n\n$ACADEMIC_PRIVILEGE_POP_EFFECTS$

entries.zh:
$living_standard_good$通过慷慨的福利政策，来改善穷困阶层的生活品质。

$living_standard_good$ strives to improve the lives of the poorer Stratas through generous social policies.

entries.zh: §L关注人民的需求是国家最重要的职责。§!
entries.en: §LSeeing to the needs of the people is the most important responsibility of the state.§!

entries.zh: $living_standard_normal$确保物种的大多数人口都能过上较为体面的生活\n\n$DECENT_LIVING_STANDARDS_POP_EFFECTS$
entries.en: $living_standard_normal$ ensures that most members of the species have what they need for an acceptable quality of life\n\n$DECENT_LIVING_STANDARDS_POP_EFFECTS$

entries.zh: §L从长远的角度来讲，忽视国民的需求百害而无一利。§!
entries.en: §LNeglecting the needs of our subjects is a losing proposition in the long run.§!

entries.zh: $living_standard_stratified$优先保障统治阶级，牺牲普罗大众的生活品质。\n\n$STRATIFIED_LIVING_STANDARDS_POP_EFFECTS$
entries.en: $living_standard_stratified$ prioritizes the ruling classes at the expense of the impoverished masses.\n\n$STRATIFIED_LIVING_STANDARDS_POP_EFFECTS$

entries.zh: §L如果他们想改善自己的状况，就得努力工作。§!
entries.en: §LIf they wish to better their lot in life, they will have to work for it.§!

entries.zh: 尽管无需供给奢侈品，但子个体仍需要大量资源来维持自身。
entries.en: While it may have little use for luxuries, a drone population still requires a great deal of resources to sustain itself.

entries.zh: §L个体的需求和主脑的需求是一致的。§!
entries.en: §LThe needs of the individual and the needs of all are one and the same.§!

entries.zh: $living_standard_subsistence$只对这个物种的人口提供最基本的物质供应。\n\n$SUBSISTENCE_POP_EFFECTS$
entries.en: $living_standard_subsistence$ offers only the most essential of goods to the Pops of this species.\n\n$SUBSISTENCE_POP_EFFECTS$

entries.zh: §L我们只需要尽可能减少臣民挨饿的问题。至于其他问题，一概不管。§!
entries.en: §LAs few as possible of our subjects should starve. Beyond that, they're not our problem.§!

entries.zh: 这个物种正处于被净化的过程中，因此不需要任何维护花费。
entries.en: This species is in the process of being purged, and Pops from it will have no Upkeep cost.

entries.zh: §L我们没有闲钱去关心这堆行尸走肉。§!
entries.en: §LWe do not budget for the dead.§!

entries.zh: 这个物种正因为脱离蜂巢思维而遭受严重的生理失常。
entries.en: This species is undergoing a difficult physiological separation from a Hive Mind.

entries.zh: 这个物种正逐渐成为统一意识的一份子。
entries.en: This species is becoming one with the unified mind.

entries.zh: §L自我意识无法在这个过程之后保留，但这就是重点。§!
entries.en: §LThe sense of self does not survive the process. But that's the point.§!

entries.zh: $living_standard_ego_assimilation_tooltip$\n\n§R由于对个体自我的摧毁，灵能相关的特质将被移除。§!
entries.en: $living_standard_ego_assimilation_tooltip$\n\n§RDue to the destruction of the individual ego, any Psionic traits will be removed.§!

entries.zh: $living_standard_ego_assimilation_tooltip$\n\n§R由于对个体自我的摧毁，灵能相关的特质将被移除。§!
entries.en: $living_standard_ego_assimilation_tooltip$\n\n§RDue to the destruction of the individual ego, any Psionic traits will be removed.§!

entries.zh: 该物种正在与机械融合。
entries.en: This species is melding with the machine.

entries.zh: $living_standard_tech_assimilation_tooltip$\n\n§R由于无法与义体植入体兼容，灵能相关的特质将被移除。§!
entries.en: $living_standard_tech_assimilation_tooltip$\n\n§RDue to incompatibility with Cybernetic implants, any Psionic traits will be removed.§!

entries.zh: 这个物种的灵能潜力正在觉醒。
entries.en: This species is awakening to its psionic potential.
§LThe veil is lifted, but the Shroud remains.§!

entries.zh: $living_standard_psi_assimilation_tooltip$\n\n§R为了达到身心的纯洁，所有义体类特质将被移除。§!
entries.en: $living_standard_psi_assimilation_tooltip$\n\n§RTo achieve purity of spirit and body, all Cybernetic traits will be removed.§!

entries.zh: 通过手段强硬的调教与养成程序，处于这个生活标准下的一小部分有机体被豢养为展品陈设。\n\n$ORGANIC_TROPHY_POP_EFFECTS$
entries.en: This living standard enshrines a small population of organic beings as display pieces, through relentless and unyielding pampering.\n\n$ORGANIC_TROPHY_POP_EFFECTS$

entries.zh: §L谁才是好的活体手办？你！就你了！§!
entries.en: §LWho's a good Bio-Trophy? You are! Yes you are!§!

entries.zh: 娱乐媒体就像毒品一样让他们沉迷其中无法自拔。这个状态下的人口十分幸福，但是无法正常工作。\n\n$living_standard_chemical_bliss_happiness_tooltip$
entries.en: Entertainment media is made freely available as a drug regimen induces a euphoric stupor. The Pops are happy, but useless.\n\n$living_standard_chemical_bliss_happiness_tooltip$

entries.zh: §L他们都喜欢游戏和娱乐活动，尽管一开始嘴上还在抵制。§!
entries.en: §LThey all welcome the games and diversions. Some resist the drugs, at first.§!

entries.zh: $living_standard_decadent$优先将更多的资源和奢侈品供应给社会的特权人员。\n\n$DECADENT_LIVING_STANDARDS_POP_EFFECTS$
entries.en: $living_standard_decadent$ prioritizes more resources and luxuries for privileged members of society.\n\n$DECADENT_LIVING_STANDARDS_POP_EFFECTS$

entries.zh: §L我们只值得拥有最好的。他们必须服务，而我们必须享受。§!
entries.en: §LWe deserve only the best. They must serve, we must rejoice.§!

entries.zh: $living_standard_dystopian_society$ 中唯有统治阶级才可以获得必需品，更低的阶级被完全忽视掉。\n\n$DYSTOPIAN_LIVING_STANDARDS_POP_EFFECTS$
entries.en: $living_standard_dystopian_society$ makes the ruling class the only recipient of necessities, completely neglecting the lower classes.\n\n$DYSTOPIAN_LIVING_STANDARDS_POP_EFFECTS$

entries.zh: §L普通的乌合之众应对自己的地位有自知之明，如果没有，那我们会教他们有。§!
entries.en: §LThe common rabble should know their place. If they don't, we will have to show them.§!

entries.zh: $living_standard_worker_ownership$保证每一位劳工在企业中均享有民主的股份。生活费用和社会责任会平均分配给所有成员。
entries.en: $living_standard_worker_ownership$ guarantees every worker a democratic share in their enterprise. Living costs and social responsibilities are distributed evenly to all members.

entries.zh: §L让所有人都拥有发言权和股份、都能分享由我们的劳动所建立的社会的红利。§!
entries.en: §LTo each a voice, a share, and the dividends of a society built by our labor.§!

entries.zh: §E所有非主要物种的自定义权利都会被重置为默认权利。§!
entries.en: §EAll customized rights set for non-primary Species will be changed to match the Default Rights.§!

entries.zh: §E该物种的所有自定义权利都会被重设为默认权利。§!
entries.en: §EAll customized rights set for this Species will be changed to match the Default Rights.§!

entries.zh: §E该物种的所有自定义权利都会被重设为创始物种权利。§!
entries.en: §EAll customized rights set for this Species will be changed to match the Founder Species Rights.§!

entries.zh: §E该物种的所有自定义权利都会被重设为机器人默认权利。§!
entries.en: §EAll customized rights set for this Species will be changed to match the Robot Default Species Rights.§!

entries.zh: §R无法在所有物种选项卡中设置物种权利。§!
entries.en: §RSpecies Rights cannot be set from All Species Tab.§!

entries.zh: §R无法在所有物种选项卡中设置默认值。§!
entries.en: §RDefault cannot be set from All Species Tab.§!

entries.zh: §R无法在所有物种选项卡中创建或修改模板。§!
entries.en: §RTemplate cannot be created or modified from All Species Tab.§!

entries.zh: §R无法在所有五中选项卡中应用模板。§!
entries.en: §RTemplate cannot be applied from All Species Tab.§!

entries.zh: 受影响的人口会被消灭——这是现有的最快速的净化方式。
entries.en: Affected Pops are systematically eradicated. This is the fastest form of Purging available.

entries.zh: §L灭绝小组的效率非常高，虽然清理整个物种是很耗时的工作，但他们却总能完成任务。§!
entries.en: §LThe extermination squads are efficient. The dissolution of entire populations naturally takes time, but they get the job done.§!

entries.zh: 受影响的人口会慢慢被赶走出我方领土，他们只能在其他地区寻求庇护。
entries.en: Affected Pops are expelled from our nation over time, left to find refuge outside our borders.

entries.zh: §L并不是我们将他们逐出家园，只是这里已经不再是他们的家园了。§!
entries.en: §LIt's not that we drive them from their homes. Their homes are simply no longer theirs.§!

entries.zh: 受影响的人口不再成长并且会逐渐随着衰老消亡，但是他们只会产生适度的§R幸福度§!惩罚。
entries.en: Affected Pops no longer grow and will die out over time, but gain only a moderate §RHappiness§! penalty.

entries.zh: §L适者生存，劣者淘汰。我们的国家将迈向未来，但是这一未来并不包括所有人。§!
entries.en: §LThink of it as a phasing-out of a people. Our nation goes to meet the future, only some will not be with us.§!

entries.zh: 受影响的人口将服终身苦役。他们将被用于生产£food£§H食物§!（或等价物）只有死亡才能解除他们的苦痛。
entries.en: Affected Pops are worked to death and can be used to produce £food£ §HFood§! (or equivalent) until their eventual demise.

entries.zh: §L死掉之前，他们至少还能派上点用处。§!
entries.en: §LWith this sacrifice, they will at least have been of some use.§!

entries.zh: 受影响的人口将会被加工成[Root.GetPurgeProcessingResource]，直到其死亡为止。
entries.en: Affected Pops are processed into [Root.GetPurgeProcessingResource] availability until death.

entries.zh: §L这是个悲哀但是无法回避的现实：某些低等物种注定将成为燃料，为上位物种的野心而燃烧。§!
entries.en: §LIt is a sad but inescapable fact that some are destined to simply fuel the ambitions of their betters.§!

entries.zh: 受影响的人口会被整合进能源网络，其维持生存的化学反应将会被重新导向以增加我们的能源储备。该过程致命但缓慢。
entries.en: Affected Pops' physiologies are prepared for integration with the energy grid, where the chemical processes that sustain them are redirected to enrich our energy stores. The process is fatal, but death comes slowly.

entries.zh: §L他们很快将被改造为更高效的形态。§!
entries.en: §LThey will soon attain a more efficient form.§!

entries.zh: 受影响的人口会被逐渐尸解为[From.GetSpeciesAdj]物种，无论其自身的意志如何。
entries.en: Affected Pops are gradually subsumed into the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] race, whether they wish it or not.

entries.zh: §L唯有最强壮的一族才能在这危机四伏的星海中生存。秉此之道，他们的事业将有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]继续践行。§!
entries.en: §LOnly the strongest may survive in a hostile galaxy. This way, their journey may continue as [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: 替代化学处理的长远方案，保证有足够的有机人口存活以为我们的电网提供源源不断的能源。
entries.en: A long-term alternative to Chemical Processing, where enough of the organic population survives the process to continue to power our energy grid indefinitely.

entries.zh: §L这个加上聚变能源，我们的能源将取之不尽。§!
entries.en: §LCombined with a form of fusion, we have found all the energy we will ever need.§!

entries.zh: §H移民控制§!可以防止此物种的人口在我们境内的星球之间随意移民。
entries.en: §HMigration Controls§! prevent Pops of this species from moving freely between our worlds.

entries.zh: §L人口自由流动可以让资源分配更加高效，但有时效率并非我们最关心的事情。§!
entries.en: §LThe free flow of Pops can allocate resources efficiently, but sometimes what is necessary is not efficient.§!

entries.zh: §H无移民控制§!可以允许此物种的人口在我们的殖民地之间随意移民。
entries.en: §HNo Migration Controls§! allows Pops of this species to move between our colonies unrestricted.

entries.zh: §L正如我们的祖先曾漫步四方寻找家园，所有生命都有在星辰中追寻自己命运的权利。§!
entries.en: §LJust as our ancestors wandered in search of a home, every being must be free to seek its destiny among the stars.§!

entries.zh: §H人口控制§!可以防止此物种的人口肆意增长或组装。
entries.en: §HPopulation Controls§! prevent Pops of this species from being grown or assembled.

entries.zh: §L只要一个物种的日常生计稍有改变，它们的人口统计数据就会成为我们的玩物。§!
entries.en: §LWith slight alterations to the daily sustenance of a species their demographics become our plaything.§!

entries.zh: §L一个无法繁衍的物种很快就会仅存于历史的长河之中了。§!
entries.en: §LA species that does not propagate itself is soon to be history.§!

entries.zh: §H殖民权利§!决定此物种是否有登陆殖民舰船前往新世界殖民的权利。
entries.en: §HColonization Rights§! determines whether this Species is allowed to board colony ships and settle new worlds.

entries.zh: §L在冰冷虚无的无垠太空，宜居星球绝对是无价之宝。但并非所有生命都配得上此等瑰宝。§!
entries.en: §LIn a vast sea of cold emptiness, a habitable world is the greatest treasure of all. Not all are worthy to seize it.§!

entries.zh: §L我们凭什么去否定某个物种征服星辰大海的梦想？唯有大家齐心协力，才有望战胜无边无际的黑暗。§!
entries.en: §LWho are we to deny any species their place among the stars? Together we will drive back the darkness.§!

entries.zh: §L每个亚种都是同一套基因基础的不同表达，都将多元化的杰出优势展现得淋漓尽致。§!
entries.en: §LEach subspecies, a unique expression of the same genetic foundation, showcases a remarkable ability to diversify.§!

entries.zh: 该亚种将会逐渐自动调整以符合默认模板。\n\n每个殖民地每月默认同化的£pop£§H人口§!数：§Y25§!
entries.en: This sub-species is automatically altered over time to match the Default Template.\n\nDefault amount of £pop£ §HPops§! Integrated per Colony per Month: §Y25§!

entries.zh: §L抛弃了多样化的纷繁复杂，专一的物种能在汇流于单一条演化的路径中寻得至简大道。§!
entries.en: §LA unified species finds simplicity and focus in a shared evolutionary trajectory by shedding the complexities of variety.§!

entries.zh: 受影响的人口必须是§Y不可接触者§!
$TRIGGER_FAIL$受影响的人口不能是§Y不可接触者§!
$TRIGGER_FAIL$受影响的人口不是§Y侍从状态§!
$TRIGGER_FAIL$受影响的人口是§Y不可接触者§!或§Y被绝育§!，或被选中作为§Y$purge_cosmogenesis_lathe_resettle$§!。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Affected Pops are §Ynot Undesirables§!, are §YNeutered§!, or are selected for §Y$purge_cosmogenesis_lathe_resettle$§!.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$受影响的人口没有正在经受§Y$purge_neutering$§!
$TRIGGER_FAIL$受影响的人口是§Y自由人口§!或§Y奴隶兵§!。
$TRIGGER_FAIL$受影响人口是§Y奴隶劳工§!或§Y侍仆§!。
$TRIGGER_FAIL$受影响的人口不为§Y奴隶劳工§!或§Y侍仆§!。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Affected Pops are not §YChattel Slaves§! or §YDomestic Servants§!.

entries.zh: 受影响的人口是§Y奴隶劳工§!或§Y牲口§!
$TRIGGER_FAIL$受影响的人口不是自由人口，也不是§Y奴隶兵§!或§Y契约奴隶§!。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Affected Pops are not free, §YBattle Thralls§! or §YIndentured Servants§!.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$这个物种无法接入我们的中央处理器。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$This species cannot interface with our empire.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$这个物种无法融入我们的意识。
$TRIGGER_FAIL$物种必须是§Y奴隶§!、具有§Y$citizenship_limited$§!公民权或者正在被§Y驱逐§!。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Species must be §YSlaves§!, have §Y$citizenship_limited$§! citizenship rights or be undergoing §YDisplacement§!.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$受影响的人口不能是§Y牲口§!或者被§Y并入电网§!。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Affected Pops may not be §YLivestock§! or §YGrid Amalgamated§!.

entries.zh: 我们帝国有$POPULATION|Y$名$SPECIES|H$人口居住在$PLANETS|H$颗行星上。
entries.en: We have $POPULATION|Y$ Pops of $SPECIES|H$ living on $PLANETS|H$ planet(s) in our Empire.

entries.zh: 我们的星系已知有$POPULATION|Y$名$SPECIES|H$人口居住在$PLANETS|H$颗星球上。
entries.en: We know of $POPULATION|Y$ Pops of $SPECIES|H$ living on $PLANETS|H$ planet(s) in our Galaxy.

entries.en: §GClick to quickly navigate the camera to where $PLANETNAME|H$ is located§!

entries.en: Modify the Traits of this Species, effectively creating a new Species.

entries.zh: 对可修饰人口§H应用物种模板§!，这能够改变它们的基因特质。选中的人口越多，进行基因修饰的花费就越高。
entries.en: §HApply Species Template§! to eligible Pops, altering their Traits. Cost increases with the number of Pops selected.

entries.zh: §H提升§!\n我们可以提升该未开化物种，让他们完全成为我们帝国的成员。
entries.en: §HUplifting§!\nWe may Uplift this pre-sapient Species to full-fledged Pops in our Empire.

entries.zh: §G点击修饰该物种的特质并创建一个新的物种模板§!
entries.en: §GClick to Modify the traits of this Species and create a new Species Template§!

entries.en: §GClick to choose Pops and apply the traits of this template on them§!

entries.zh: 默认模板是该物种的主模板，所有归属于有§H亚种整合§!的模板的人口都将按此模板进行修饰。
entries.en: Default templates are the main templates of their species, any pop in templates that are set to §HSub-Species Integration§! will be modified to change into this template.

entries.zh: 您是否确定要将该模板设为此物种的默认模板？\n\n§R将影响正在被整合的该物种人口。§!
entries.en: Are you sure you want to set this template as this Species Default?\n\n§RPops from this species who are being assimilated will be affected.§!

entries.zh: §T我们可以投票将联盟转变为联邦§!
entries.en: §TWe can vote to transform our Alliance into a full Federation§!

entries.zh: 是否确认投票成立联邦？
entries.en: Do you want to vote to form a Federation?

entries.zh: 联邦主席不会变更，因为没有力量更加强大的成员来担任领袖。
entries.en: The Federation President will not change, as there is no other member powerful enough to assume leadership.

entries.zh: §H联邦舰队§!是由联邦主席国控制的特殊舰队。他们在§H联邦舰船设计器§!中进行设计，在设计之中可以使用联邦各国最顶尖的科技。联邦舰队不需要维护费，但是总量不可以超过§H联邦海军容量§!上限，每个联邦成员至少要贡献他们§Y$PERC|0%$§!的§H海军容量§!。
entries.en: §HFederation Fleets§! are special fleets that are controlled by the Federation President. They are designed in the §HFederation Ship Designer§! and can use any technology available to any member of the Federation. Federation Fleets cost no upkeep, but cannot exceed the §HFederation Naval Capacity§!, to which each member contributes at least §Y$PERC|0%$§! of their own §HNaval Capacity§!.

entries.zh: 决定游戏的整体视觉效果。
entries.en: Determines the overall quality of visual effects in the game.

entries.zh: §H低§!：适合使用集成显卡的设备。使用较小的纹理，降低或关闭大多数视觉特效，尤其是星系视图，保证配置较低的电脑获得流畅的体验。
entries.en: §HLow§!: Suited to devices running on integrated GPUs. Smaller textures are used and many visual effects have been disabled or reduced, especially in the galaxy view, to ensure smooth game play on low-end machines.

entries.zh: §H中§!：使用高分辨率的纹理，但降低了一些视觉特效，尤其是星系界面。在提升画面效果的同时兼顾性能稳定。
entries.en: §HMedium§!: High resolution textures are used but some effects have been downgraded, especially in the galaxy view. Provides a good balance between visual quality and performance.

entries.zh: §H高§!：开启所有图形特效，使用高分辨率纹理。
entries.en: §HHigh§!: All visual effects are enabled and high resolution textures are used.

entries.zh:
决定游戏窗口的显示方式。

§H全屏幕§!：游戏将全屏显示，你的显示器分辨率将会变更为当前选择的分辨率。

§H窗口化§!：游戏将用选定的分辨率窗口化显示。

§H无边框全屏幕§!：游戏将会以桌面大小的窗口显示，置于所有窗口之前。
entries.en:
Determines how the game window will be displayed.

§HFull Screen§!: The game will be displayed full screen and your monitor's resolution will be changed to match the chosen resolution.

§HWindowed§!: The game will be displayed in a window at the chosen resolution.

§HBorderless Fullscreen§!: The game will be displayed in a window, which is set to the size of your desktop and appears in front of all other windows.
Determines which renderer is being used.

entries.zh: 决定游戏窗口的像素尺寸。
entries.en: Determines the size of the game window in pixels.

entries.zh: 使用全屏幕模式时，§H刷新率§!决定了显示器的每秒重绘次数。在窗口化或无边框模式中，将采取桌面的刷新率。
entries.en: When running in full screen mode, the §HRefresh Rate§! determines how many times per second your monitor will redraw the screen. In Windowed or Borderless mode, the refresh rate of your desktop will be used.

entries.zh: §H多重采样§!会在渲染时平滑锯齿边缘。设置得越高，占用资源越多，但也会带来更好的画面表现。使用较老的硬件时，将该值设为0来提高性能。
entries.en: §HMultisampling§! smooths jagged edges during rendering. A higher value will produce a better result at the cost of performance. Set this to 0 if running on older hardware to improve performance.

entries.zh: §H用户界面缩放§!的最大值取决于你的§H分辨率§!。分辨率越高，§H用户界面缩放§!就可以调的更高。请注意勿将此值设置得过高，否则部分用户界面要素会超出屏幕，无法使用。
entries.en: Maximum §HUI Scaling§! depends on your §HResolution§!. Higher resolutions will allow a higher §HUI Scaling§!. Take care not to use too high values, or UI elements may become inaccessible.

entries.zh: 更高的§H泛光质量§!会牺牲少量性能，提供更广泛、更平滑的泛光效果。

If set to §YOn§!, whenever an event is triggered, the game will automatically pause. $DEFAULT_BRACKET$
$SEPARATOR$

entries.zh: §H$SETTINGS_AUTO_UNPAUSE_LABEL$§!\n若勾选，游戏将会在关闭所有导致游戏暂停的事件弹窗之后自动解除暂停。$DEFAULT_BRACKET$

§H信息种类§!

entries.en: £pop£ §HMachine Pops§! do not grow but are built

entries.zh: 这些超自然粒子蕴含有惊人的能量，可以被精炼为能源或者用作燃料和炸药。
entries.en: These preternatural particles contain a tremendous amount of energy which could be exploited in energy production, as fuel or even as explosives.

entries.zh: 罕见的异星天然气拥有各种用途，主要是用来为高级能量武器和能量力场提供能源。部分也用作舰船燃料或消遣性毒品。
entries.en: Rare and exotic gases with a variety of different uses, particularly in the operation of advanced energy-based weaponry and force fields. Some of the gases can also be used as starship fuel or even as recreational drugs.

entries.zh: 这些水晶拥有独特的属性，非常适合用来凝聚和集中激光束，同时也是制作大部分高级电子器材的关键材料。部分文化也视之为装饰物。
entries.en: These crystals have properties that make them extremely effective at focusing laser beams, and they are also a critical component in most advanced electronics. In addition, many cultures treasure them as decorations and adornments.
