entries.zh: 一种在异星粒子中存在的极其稀有的气溶胶，随着陨石撞击被一起发现。不过其真正的来源依然是个未解之谜。若拥有灵能天赋的[GetIndividualNamePlural]将泽珞[GetIngestedLoc]后，它会是一种能极大的提高灵能力量（并可能导致成瘾）的[GetDrugLoc]。
entries.en: An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If [GetIngestedLoc] by psionically-gifted [GetIndividualNamePlural], zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) [GetDrugLoc] that enhances psionic abilities.

entries.zh: 该无机金属有着通常生命体才具备的特征。会自动恢复到其被塑造好的形态。
entries.en: This inorganic metal shows characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms. It will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.

entries.zh: 这种神秘物质具有许多似乎可以打破所谓自然法则的性质。该物质仅在黑洞周围或部分星云附近才能达到可供开采的浓度。
entries.en: This exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy several natural laws. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.

entries.zh: 简单而高效的纳米致动器，可以执行纳米水平的复杂操作和实验。
entries.en: Simple but powerful nanoactuators, allowing for complex manipulations and experiments of mesoscopic scales.

entries.zh: 这些温顺的生物很容易被奴役，其友善的举止和可爱的外表让它们成为宠物的不二之选。亲外者们十分喜爱这些生物，并且自豪地在他们的动物园里展示。
entries.en: These docile non-sapient creatures can easily be domesticated, and their friendly demeanor and appealing looks would make them popular as pets and companions. Xenophiles value them highly and proudly present them in their zoos.

entries.zh: 陨石撞击留下的稀有矿石。燃烧消耗慢，是一种高效能源。
entries.en: These rare stones have been deposited on many worlds through meteor strikes. They burn very slowly and are very efficient energy sources.

entries.zh: 零素是一种由中子构成的超高密度物质，可用作超强耐性船体的锻造材料。
entries.en: Neutronium is a super-dense substance composed of neutrons that can be forged into extremely resistant hulls.

entries.zh: 发电站可以生产能量币，是维护大多建筑和舰船的必要资源。
entries.en: Power Plants produce Energy Credits, necessary for maintaining most buildings and ships.

entries.zh: 贝塞里安发电站会消耗贝塞里安石来产出大量能量币。
entries.en: Betharian Power Plants consume Betharian Stone to produce vast amounts of Energy Credits.

entries.zh: 水培农场生产富含营养的蔬菜植物，供当地人口消耗。
entries.en: Hydroponics Farms produce nutrient-rich vegetable matter tailored for consumption by local Pops.

entries.zh: 复合矿场是从行星的地壳中开采重要矿物的设施。
entries.en: Mining Networks extract crucial Minerals from the planet's crust.

entries.zh: 科学研究所为一般性质的研究提供基础设施，可以升级成专攻某一学科的研究所。
entries.en: Science Labs provide the basic facilities for general research, and can be Upgraded for more specialized functionality.
§RCan only be built on the capital planet.§!

entries.zh: 克隆仓将简单点物质分解用于产生有机人口增长。
entries.en: Clone Vats break down simple materials to generate Organic Pop Growth.

entries.zh: §R注释：有机和机械人口组装彼此独立，且不叠加。§!
entries.en: §RNote: Organic and Mechanical Pop Assembly are mutually exclusive and do not stack.§!

entries.zh: 这栋庞大且充满威压的设施用于处理奴隶劳役，消除任何自由意志的苗头。
entries.en: This large and imposing facility is used to process slave labor and extinguish any trace of free will.

entries.zh: 当地失业的§Y$SLAVES$§!和无智慧机器人将允许向其他殖民地§Y自动迁移§!。
entries.en: §YAutomatic Resettlement§! to other colonies is enabled for local unemployed §Y$SLAVES$§! and non-sapient robots.

entries.zh: 机器人组装工厂是建立机器人军团的必要设施。\n每年增加§Y100§!£pop£§H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_1$人口§!\n人口维护：£energy£ §Y1§!
entries.en: A Robotics Assembly Plant is required for the creation of robotic armies.\nAdds §Y100§! £pop£ §H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_1$ Pops§! per Year\nPop Upkeep: £energy£ §Y1§!

entries.zh:
智能人装配工厂是建立机器人军队所必需的。
每年增加§Y100§!£pop£§H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_2$人口§!
将§H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_1$§!人口升级到§H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_2$§!
人口维护费：£energy£ §Y2§!
entries.en:
A Droid Assembly Plant is required for the creation of robotic armies.
Adds §Y100§! £pop£ §H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_2$ Pops§! per Year
Upgrades Pops of §H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_1$§! to §H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_2$§!
Pop Upkeep: £energy£ §Y2§!

entries.zh:
合成人组装工厂是建立机器人军团的必要设施。
每年增加§Y100§!§H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_3$人口§!
将§H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_2$§!的人口升级到§H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_3$§!
人口维护费：£energy£ §Y5§!
entries.en:
A Synthetic Assembly Plant is required for the creation of robotic armies.
Adds §Y100§! £pop£ §H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_3$ Pops§! per Year
Upgrades Pops of §H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_2$§! to §H$ROBOT_POP_SPECIES_3$§!
Pop Upkeep: £energy£ §Y5§!

entries.zh: 由一艘殖民船的剩余部分改装，作为登陆星球的临时据点。
entries.en: The remains of a Colony Ship, reassembled for planetside form and function.

entries.zh: 地方统治精英的所在地。
entries.en: Seat of the local ruling elite.

entries.zh: 各色官僚机构组成的复合体，是大型殖民地的行政中心。
entries.en: A sprawling complex of bureaucratic structures that acts as the administrative center for a major colony.

entries.zh: 高耸入云的行政官僚机构和密密麻麻的交通要道，使得各类设施与建筑在此建造并高效运转。
entries.en: A towering configuration of administrative bureaus and networked infrastructure, allowing the construction and operation of highly demanding facilities.

entries.zh: §L这座古老的大型设施使用了失传已久的科技。§!
entries.en: §LThis ancient complex was built with technology long since lost to the ages.§!

entries.zh: §L储备了浩如烟海的远古知识。§!
§L这座古老的大型设施使用了失传已久的科技。§!
entries.en: §LThis ancient complex was built with technology long since lost to the ages.§!

entries.zh: §L这座古老的大型设施使用了失传已久的科技。§!
entries.en: §LThis ancient complex was built with technology long since lost to the ages.§!

entries.zh: 原始的农场，通过耕种土地获得低效的收成。
entries.en: Primitive farmsteads working the soil for meager returns.

entries.zh: 原始、低效的工厂，生产商品的同时会造成污染。
entries.en: Primitive, inefficient factories spewing pollution while producing goods.

entries.zh: 这些办公室里似乎有无穷无尽的小隔间，充斥着毫无意义的忙碌工作声。
entries.en: These offices contain seemingly endless cubicles, with the sounds of pointless busywork.

entries.zh: 在地下蜿蜒的原始矿坑。
entries.en: Primitive mining tunnels that snake through the ground.

entries.zh: 一座原始而且不怎么可靠的发电厂，依靠煤矿或是早期原子科技发电，对当地大气造成污染。
entries.en: A primitive and somewhat unreliable power plant that relies on coal or early atomic power, poisoning their atmosphere.

entries.zh: 死去的突变体堆叠在一起构成恐怖的景象。不稳定的有机物质扭曲在一起，形成了某种结构。
entries.en: A putrid mass of dead mutated horrors. Their volatile organic matter has twisted together to form a structure of sorts.

entries.zh: 这些帐篷标记了通向巨大地下避难所的入口，这个世界的原住民把它当作防空洞。当食物耗尽后，避难所的居民反目成仇。
entries.en: These tents mark the surface entrance to a massive underground vault, intended as a bomb shelter by this world's original inhabitants. The vault's occupants turned on each other when their food ran out.

entries.zh: 这些帐篷标记了通向巨大地下避难所的入口，这个世界的原住民把它当作防空洞。这个避难所还包含一个巨大的机械停放处，以及许多售卖采矿设备的商店。
entries.en: These tents mark the surface entrance to a massive underground vault, intended as a bomb shelter by this world's original inhabitants. The vault contains a huge machine park along with stores of mining equipment.

entries.zh: 十分古老的粒子加速器，其构造却很有新意。从还能够运行的部件中可以获取大量研究资料。这些资料一定是由某个天才物理学家收集整合的。
entries.en: This old particle accelerator was built using a novel design, and the surviving terminals within the structure contain a massive amount of research data composed by what must have been a brilliant theoretical physicist.

entries.zh: 十分精妙的工厂，似乎是某个文明遗留在这个星球上的。可以生产珍贵资源。
entries.en: A well-crafted facility that produces high value resources, left on the planet by a different civilization.

entries.zh: 一家临时医院，致力于帮助感染者以求开发出疫苗。
entries.en: A temporary hospital with a focus on studying infected in order to produce a cure.

entries.zh: 一座纪念碑，提醒人们不要忘记那场席卷家园的可怕疫病。它是见证着帝国幸存下来的纪念碑。
entries.en: A memorial to remind the people of the horrible disease that once haunted their home. Stands as a testament to the survival of the nation.

entries.zh: 精密布局的电力传输网络可以有效提升发电站的电力输出。
entries.en: A carefully calibrated grid network maximizes the output of power generators.

entries.zh: 生产£energy£§Y能源§!岗位的基础生产提高§G1§!。
entries.en: Increases the base production of £energy£ §YEnergy§! producing jobs by §G1§!.

entries.zh: 此巨型设施可以将该行星上的所有电力中心集中在一块，有效提高电力中心的效率。
entries.en: This colossal facility centralizes all energy grids on the planet, improving their efficiency.

entries.zh: 这个处理站会将粗矿精炼成最高质量的矿物。
entries.en: Minerals that have passed through these purifiers are of the highest quality.

entries.zh: 此庞大的中心空间站会接收矿物然后分配给各个矿物处理站精炼出优质矿物。
entries.en: Massive hubs where minerals are received and then shuttled to arrays of purifiers.

entries.zh: 基因诊所能够提供先进的医疗技术，整体提高人口的健康程度和寿命。
entries.en: Gene Clinics can offer advanced medical treatments, which statistically lead to a significantly healthier and longer-living population.

entries.zh: 细胞修复中心能够为大众提供先进的医疗技术。细胞层面的治疗会整体提高人口的健康程度和寿命。
entries.en: Cyto-Revitalization Centers can offer advanced medical treatments to a large population. Treatments on a cellular level lead to a significantly healthier and longer-living population.

entries.zh: 矿物储蓄仓能提高帝国的最大矿物存储容量。
entries.en: Mineral Silos increase our Empire's maximum Mineral storage capacity.

entries.zh: 为纪念最初踏足星空的先驱者而建立的纪念碑。
entries.en: A monument to the first pioneers to venture into space.

entries.zh: 帝国每采用一个§Y飞升天赋§!就产生£unity£§G1§!。\n\n
entries.en: Produces £unity£§G1§! for each §YAscension Perk§! our Empire has taken.\n\n

entries.zh: 纪念我们帝国与人民的早期历史的遗迹。
entries.en: An area dedicated to the early history of our empire and its people.

entries.zh: 帝国每采用一个§Y飞升天赋§!就产生£unity£§G2§!。\n\n
entries.en: Produces £unity£§G2§! for each §YAscension Perk§! our Empire has taken.\n\n

entries.zh: 一个装备有先进人际通讯装置的巨大设施，提供了在讨论中交流多种观点与在辩论中快速形成共识的平台。
entries.en: An immense facility equipped with avant-garde interpersonal communications equipment, the Forum allows for the exchange of multisensory ideas in casual discussions and rapid consensus-forming in debates.

entries.zh: 帝国每采用一个§Y飞升天赋§!就产生£unity£§G3§!。\n\n
entries.en: Produces £unity£§G3§! for each §YAscension Perk§! our Empire has taken.\n\n

entries.zh: 一个高度专业化的计算机网络不断地获取，分析，评估并展示它认为重要的日常生活物品，创造了一个活生生的当代博物馆。
entries.en: A highly-specialized computerized network constantly acquires, analyzes, evaluates, and puts on display everyday artifacts it deems to be significant, creating a living museum of the present.

entries.zh: 作为太古时代便矗立着的简单建筑，神殿一直充当着是静思和同神灵交流的场所。
entries.en: Simple constructs erected since time immemorial, temples are places of quiet contemplation and communion with that which unites us all.

entries.zh: 之前粗糙的神殿的经过升级与改造，使用了最新的灵能科技在全息神殿内部创造出了亦真亦幻的现实，信徒们可以借此进入更深层次的冥思并激发出更加热烈的奉献精神。
entries.en: An enhanced form of its rough-hewn predecessors, the latest in Spiritualist technology creates a mutable reality inside the Holotemple - all for deeper meditation and more intense devotion.

entries.zh: 最新的精神场科技，能够让朝拜者直接感受到来自圣地的神圣力量。
entries.en: The latest developments in field technology allow worshipers to directly experience the divine influence of sacred ground.

entries.zh: 一个巨大的与物质世界隔离的建筑，接受一切来访者，为他们提供避难所。
entries.en: A massive complex offering refuge and seclusion from the material world, for all comers.

entries.zh: 一个行星要塞，拥有强大的驻军，以保护该星球免遭入侵和叛乱。
entries.en: A planetary stronghold housing a substantial garrison force to protect the world from invasion and rebellion.

entries.zh: 此巨型要塞群内置有更大型的兵营以容纳更多的驻守士兵并同时为他们提供训练场所。
entries.en: A massive fortress complex with an expanded garrison and training facilities for soldiers.

entries.zh: 此设施可以高效地将有机物质转化为能源。
entries.en: A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate.

entries.zh: 一座将有机质高效转化为能量的设施，对废物控制的改进使其可以回收有用的气态副产物。
entries.en: A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate, improvements in waste collection allows harvesting of useful gaseous by-products.

entries.zh: 居住站的这个地区致力于安保，并提供武装部队来保护居住地免受来自内部和外部的威胁。
entries.en: This section of the Habitat is dedicated to security and provides an armed security force to protect the Habitat from threats within and without.

entries.zh: 原始社会的住房，由岩石和粘土等材料所建造。
entries.en: Primitive shelters constructed out of stone, clay or whatever other materials were available.

entries.zh: 这些小型建筑可以提供简单的住宿环境，有效防御各种恶劣的气候。
entries.en: These small buildings provide a minimal amount of shelter, but they keep out the worst of the elements.

entries.zh: 当地统治精英居住的石头建造的原始宫殿。
entries.en: Primitive palaces built out of stone, where the local ruling elite resides.

entries.zh: 这个原始星球居住着的各个民族国家的地区首府建筑。
entries.en: The regional capital buildings of the various nation-states inhabiting this primitive world.

entries.zh: 处于环境污染严重的水泥森林中的空间紧凑型房屋。
entries.en: Cramped and often polluted jungles of concrete.

entries.zh: 一处射电望远镜构成的阵列，希望能够寻找到有智慧的外星生命。
entries.en: An array of radio telescopes in pursuit of discovering intelligent alien life.

entries.zh: 随时间提高这个文明获得£awareness£§Y觉醒度§!的几率。
entries.en: Increases the chance of this civilization gaining £awareness£ §YAwareness§! over time.

entries.zh: 使用最简单、无需多少功夫就能获取的低级材料制成，这些蜂巢仅能保证工蜂不会在夜间被冻死。
entries.en: Using the simplest and low effort material available, these nests are barely enough to keep drones from freezing during the nights.

entries.zh: 这些六边形建筑在建造时已经开始考虑空间利用的最优化，因此可以容纳基本上可以称之为一个群落的人口。
entries.en: Starting to optimize the space available, these hexagon shaped buildings can house what could moderately be called a colony.

entries.zh: 在这样一个世界，你需要同自己物种竞争来求生存，那么拥有石制的城墙无疑是一项优势。
entries.en: In a world where you need to compete against your own species for survival, having stone walls is an advantage.

entries.zh: 从这个典型的大陆中心节点不断延伸出无数蜂巢，争相控制这颗星球。
entries.en: The typical central point of the continent spanning hives vying for control over this world.

entries.zh: 一种容纳正在进行休眠循环的工蜂的最实用方案。建筑上设置了分立的入口和出口，能够最大化工蜂的补能进程。
entries.en: A utilitarian solution for housing drones when they are undergoing their rest cycle. There are separate entrances and exits to maximize the hive's recharge process.

entries.zh: 通过这个简陋的突触节点，蜂巢的意志将得到强化。
entries.en: Through this crude synaptic node, the will of the Hive will be strengthened.

entries.zh: 一个降低行星延迟的简陋上行链路节点。
entries.en: An crude uplink node that decreases planetary latency.

entries.zh: 一个谦逊的官僚中心，其任务是测量耕地并发起行星农业的扩张。
entries.en: A modest bureaucratic center tasked with surveying arable land and initiating expansion of planetary agriculture.

entries.zh: 该中心的重点是恢复边缘土地和提高产量，促进更大的农业区域增长。
entries.en: This center focuses on restoring marginal land and improving yields, allowing for greater agricultural district growth.

entries.zh: 机械化收割机、无人机编队和气候控制农田推动了农业区划的迅速扩张。
entries.en: Mechanized harvesters, drone fleets, and climate-controlled fields drive the rapid expansion of agricultural districts.

entries.zh: 一座庞大的综合体，监督集约化、高密度的农业运作，最大限度地增加星球上可支持的农业区划。
entries.en: A vast integrated complex that oversees intensive, high-density farming operations, maximizing the number of agricultural districts supported on the planet.

entries.zh: 通过协调浅层挖掘和矿石收集，该采石站可以提前扩展采矿区划。
entries.en: By coordinating shallow-surface excavation and ore collection, this depot enables early expansion of mining districts.

entries.zh: 挖掘钻机、输送系统和分选阵列协同工作，维持着可靠的产出，并使采矿区划的初始扩展成为可能。
entries.en: Excavation rigs, conveyor systems, and sorting arrays operate in tandem to sustain reliable output and enable the initial expansion of mining districts.

entries.zh: 这是一种通过重型钻孔机和结构加固来推动更深层次采矿作业的设施，可以解锁更多的矿藏。
entries.en: A facility that drives deeper mining operations through heavy bore drills and structural reinforcements, unlocking additional mineral sites.

entries.zh: 一座可进行高效隧道开凿和地下稳定化的复杂设施，拓宽了通往其他难以到达的矿脉的通道。
entries.en: A complex equipped for high-efficiency tunnel carving and subterranean stabilization, expanding access to otherwise unreachable mineral veins.

entries.zh: 这座复杂的设施在行星的最深处运行，管理着完全工业化的采掘区，并能将采矿区划扩张到极限。
entries.en: A sprawling facility operating at maximum planetary depth, this complex manages fully industrialized extraction zones and supports the greatest possible mining district expansion.

entries.zh: 该建筑致力于大规模能源发电，其中包含了动力电池、等离子体管道和高输出发电机阵列。
entries.en: Dedicated to large-scale energy generation, this building houses power cells, plasma conduits, and high-output generator arrays.

entries.zh: 这座复合体通过分配底层电网的基础设施和能源处理系统来支持新发电区划的建立。
entries.en: This complex supports the establishment of new generator districts by distributing foundational grid infrastructure and energy handling systems.

entries.zh: 该设施通过部署大容量继电器、变压器场和电网稳定节点，扩大了行星电力基础设施，为发电区划的发展提供了更广泛的支持。
entries.en: Enabling broader support for generator district development, this facility expands planetary power infrastructure through the deployment of high-capacity relays, transformer yards, and grid stabilization nodes.

entries.zh: 该设施用稳定化等离子体流和电路共振控制整促进整个星球上的发电设施的高强度发展。
entries.en: A complex where stabilized plasma flows and circuit resonance control allow for intensified generator development across the planet.

entries.zh: 这种集成的能源中枢协调着行星规模的发电机操作，使发电区划可以扩展到极限。
entries.en: This integrated energy nexus coordinates planetary-scale generator operations, enabling the highest achievable expansion of generator districts.

entries.zh: 这块保留地专门用于保护和研究当地动物群。
entries.en: A preserve dedicated to the conservation and study of local fauna.

entries.zh: 居住站的行政中心，作为当地的首府及政府的所在地。
entries.en: The administrative hub of the Habitat, serving as its capital and the seat of the local government.

entries.zh: 大型天体产生的£mod_planet_max_districts_add£ 最大区划槽：§G+$@hab_districts_per_major_body_tier2|2$§!\n
entries.en: £mod_planet_max_districts_add£ Max District Slots from Major Celestial Bodies: §G+$@hab_districts_per_major_body_tier2|2$§!\n

entries.zh: 太阳能处理器将太阳能从居住站外侧大量的太阳能板中收集的太阳能分配到各个设施。
entries.en: Solar Power Processors distribute solar energy captured in vast arrays of solar panels located on the exterior hull of the Habitat.

entries.zh: 尽管居住站本身并没有什么自然资源，居住站可以借助这些设施从临近的小行星或天体上进行开采获取矿物资源。
entries.en: With no natural resources of their own, Habitats depend on these facilities to mine and process minerals from nearby asteroids and planetoids.

entries.zh: 居住站有一个养殖着多种植物和动物以提供食物给当地居民的区域。
entries.en: A section of the Habitat set aside for the cultivation of various plants and animals needed by the local population.

entries.zh: 成片的综合设施成为了居住站住民们用以满足文化与社交需求的区域。
entries.en: This sprawling complex tends to the cultural and social needs of the Habitat's inhabitants.

entries.zh: 完全用于科学研究的独立区域。
entries.en: A section of the Habitat dedicated entirely to the scientific pursuits.

entries.zh: 一个为“幸存下来”的异种生物提供自然栖息地的高度复杂的保护区。
entries.en: A highly sophisticated preserve that maintains the natural habitat of the "preserved" alien species perfectly.

entries.zh: 完全封闭性并拥有自给生态系统的住房，对那些富有或者运气足够好的人来说这里是名副其实的天堂。
entries.en: A fully enclosed habitation dome with a self-contained ecosystem, a veritable private paradise for those rich or fortunate enough to live there.

entries.zh: 一座纪念伟大统治者的纪念碑。
entries.en: A monument honoring a great ruler.

entries.zh: 纪念伟大的[GetRulerName]的巨型纪念碑。
entries.en: A colossal monument honoring the great [GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 一座巨大的陵墓，搭建在伟大统治者的墓穴上。
entries.en: A huge mausoleum built to house the tomb of a great ruler.

entries.zh: 为备受尊敬的[GetRulerName]建造的庄严墓地。
entries.en: The sacred mausoleum of the revered [GetRulerName].

entries.zh:
必须拥有一个§Y统治者§!
行星上必须建立一个
§Y行星首府§!，
§Y行星都城§!，或
§Y复合型恒星系首府§!
entries.en:
Must have a §YRuler§!
Must have a
§YPlanetary Administration§!,
§YPlanetary Capital§!, or
§YEmpire Capital-Complex§!
built on the planet

entries.zh: 一座巨大的休闲花园，人们可以在这里欢聚，缅怀伟大的统治者。
entries.en: A huge recreational garden where the people may gather and rejoice in remembrance to a great ruler.

entries.zh: 伟大的[GetRulerName]建造的奇幻花园。
entries.en: A fantastic garden developed by the great [GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 通过商品和服务的自由贸易，我们提供了一种分工更加精细的经济形式，使得人们可以专攻某一行业，交易他们所需的东西。
entries.en: By engaging in free trade of goods and services we allow for a more specialized economy, where an individual can excel in a narrow field and trade for their needs.

entries.zh: 生产部是日以继夜地负责管理并优化整个行星上的流水线生产链的行政部门。
entries.en: The Ministry of Production works tirelessly to organize and streamline manufacturing across the entire planet.

entries.zh: 该庞大的设施专精于整个行星的资源管理与加工。
entries.en: A vast facility which centralizes the handling of resources and manufacturing across the entire planet.

entries.zh: 能够运行各种复杂运算的超级电脑，有助于提升整个行星的科研输出。
entries.en: A single colossal supercomputer which can carry out incredibly complex calculations, improving the research output of the whole planet.

entries.zh: 一座大型的休闲场所，犹如美梦成真。购物商场、饭店餐馆、游乐园、虚拟游戏厅，数不胜数。想要什么，这里都有！
entries.en: These massive entertainment complexes is where dreams come true. Shopping malls, restaurants, amusement parks, virtual arcades, and more. You dream it - we are it!

entries.zh: 研究中心是一座巨大而错综复杂的设施，集合了各领域一线的专家，这种空前的跨领域协作将增加整个行星的研究产值。
entries.en: The Research Institute is a massive complex, gathering the cutting edges of disparate fields together for unprecedented synergy, improving the research output of the whole planet.

entries.zh: 虚拟竞技场既可用于娱乐消遣，又能增加社会归属感。当地军团也会用虚拟竞技场来进行模拟训练。
entries.en: The Virtual Combat Arena serves both as entertainment and a means to foster communal unity. Local armies may also use the Virtual Combat Arena for virtual exercises.

entries.zh: 奥利姆矿具有独特的性质，适合加工成炸药，用于地底或深海采矿项目。
entries.en: The unique qualities of Orillium ore allows it to be processed into an easily-tuned explosive, especially suited for controlled blasts in deep mining operations.

entries.zh: 皮萨兰肥料厂生产添加皮萨兰星尘的肥料，改善作物产值。
entries.en: Pitharan Fertilizer Plants produce fertilizers using Pitharan dust as an additive, improving crop yields.

entries.zh: 军事学院可以提高当地的招募率，并能提供更高规格的训练。
entries.en: Military Academies improve local recruitment rates and offer a higher standard of training.

entries.zh: 帝国的各路精英灵能[GetIndividualNamePlural]被征召到此军团中发挥各自的专长。\n\n§Y灵能军团是你的[GetPsiCorpFriend]。相信我们。§!
entries.en: From all across our empire, psionic [GetIndividualNamePlural] are brought here to hone their abilities.\n\n§YThe Psi Corps is your [GetPsiCorpFriend]. Trust the Corps.§!

entries.zh: 增强蜂巢思维的信号能够提高我们的子个体的工作效率。
entries.en: Boosting the signal of our Hive Mind makes our drones more efficient workers.

entries.zh: 将劣等物种集中到一个地方，通过研究和展览以显示我们的先进性。
entries.en: By collecting members of weaker species in one location, we can study them and showcase them as proof of our superiority.

entries.zh: 通过建造强大的处理中心我们可以优化我们无人机的操作效率。
entries.en: By constructing powerful processing hubs we can optimize the operational efficiency of our drones.

entries.zh: §R需要行星上有§Y$building_capital_2$§!，人工智能必须合法。§!
entries.en: §RRequires §Y$building_capital_2$§! on planet. Artificial Intelligence may not be outlawed.§!

entries.zh: §R需要行星上有§Y$building_capital_3$§!，人工智能必须合法。§!
entries.en: §RRequires §Y$building_capital_3$§! on planet. Artificial Intelligence may not be outlawed.§!

entries.zh: 神秘的方尖碑，刻满失传的外星文字。涌动其中的力量发出轰鸣，靠近的人都会感觉到头痛。
entries.en: A mysterious obelisk covered in letters from a dead alien language. It hums with power and those in its proximity suffer headaches.

entries.zh: 一座当地民众为了安抚从天降临的神所建造的金字塔。
entries.en: A pyramid constructed by the local population to appease a deity descended from the sky.

entries.zh: 不停运作的大型工厂，将高分子聚合物塑造成形状各异而用途未知小物件。
entries.en: Complex machinery ceaselessly molds complex polymers into small items of varying shapes and inscrutable purpose.

entries.zh: 降低行星间的延迟的上行链路节点。
entries.en: An uplink node that decreases planetary latency.

entries.zh: 这种强大的收发器可以增加信号带宽，增进帝国内不同系统之间的不断交流。
entries.en: This powerful transceiver increases the bandwidth of the signals being continuously sent between the many different systems operating across our empire.

entries.zh: 一栋负责收发信号的庞大中心设施，联通了星海相隔的数百万个不同系统。
entries.en: A massive hub facility that receives and forwards signals across interstellar distances from millions of different systems.

entries.zh: 内部通讯的中心神经，联通着管理我们帝国的数以亿亿计的半智慧系统。
entries.en: The nerve center of all intra-communication that occurs between the quintillions of semi-sapient systems that administers our empire.

entries.zh: 半自动化的电脑网络，负责管理行星上各种复杂的行政工作。
entries.en: A semi-autonomous computer network that handles the various administrative functions on a planet.

entries.zh: 性能强大的行政电脑，负责管理与监督行星聚居点的运作。
entries.en: A powerful administrative computer that has been designed to manage and oversee the various functions of a complex planetary settlement.

entries.zh: 这里是整个系统的行政核心。数以千计的电脑智能不分昼夜地处理各种微小而繁琐的需求以确保星际文明能够保持高效的运作。
entries.en: The administrative heart of the system. Hundreds of AIs process requests and manage the minute but critical details that are involved in running an efficient interstellar civilization.

entries.zh: 这所实验室会研究栖息在当地的动物群落，以及在未来将它们整合进机械设计的潜质。
entries.en: This laboratory will study the properties of the unique animal strain that inhabits this region, and how they could potentially be applied to future machine designs.

entries.zh: 一个储藏帝国所有现役机器模型零件的大型中心化仓库。
entries.en: A large, centralized depot that contains spare parts for every currently active machine model in our empire.

entries.zh: 该由人工智能监督的工厂会大大加速该行星组装新机械单位的速度。
entries.en: This AI-supervised factory greatly speeds up the process of assembling new machine units on this world.

entries.zh: 巨大的收容设施内有一个稳定的微型黑洞。拥有近乎无限的研究潜能。
entries.en: A stable micro black hole held within a massive containment facility. The research potential is nearly unlimited.

entries.zh: 该异常强大的人工智能建筑体不断运行尖端的数学仿真，企图预测有机群落的未来行动。至少已经证实，它可以准确预测他们的股票市场。
entries.en: This exceedingly powerful AI construct is constantly running advanced mathematical simulations in a vain attempt to predict the future actions of organic societies. It has proven adept at anticipating developments on their stock markets, however.

entries.zh: 该庇护所为有机生命提供安全成长的封闭环境，而且能完全监控他们的行为。居住于其中的有机体的住房需求将被完全满足。
entries.en: This sanctuary provides a sealed environment where organics can thrive in a safe and above all controlled manner. The organics within have their housing needs completely fulfilled.

entries.zh: 一个由人工智能控制的人造乐土，专门用于满足智慧有机生命的需求。当然，这其中不包括自主自决的需求。居住于其中的有机体的住房需求将被完全满足。
entries.en: An AI-controlled artificial paradise designed to satisfy every need a sapient organic being might have, just so long as it does not express a need for self-determination. The organics within have their housing needs completely fulfilled.

entries.zh: 算法维系着活体陈设源源不断的创意输出，筛选统计显著的情感共鸣。虽然客观上缺乏技术价值，但这些表达被保留为社会情感验证的手段，并提供自决的幻觉。由此产生的满意度值的增加是非常重要的。
entries.en: Algorithms maintain a curated rotation of Bio-Trophy creative outputs, selected for their statistically significant emotional resonance. While objectively devoid of technical merit, these expressions are preserved as a means of socio-emotional validation and to provide the illusion of self-determination. The resulting increase in satisfaction metrics is non-trivial.

entries.zh: £job_cruise_passenger£$job_cruise_passenger_bio_trophy_plural$获得更高的£unity£凝聚力产出、£consumer_goods£消费品维护费以及幸福度。\n£job_cruise_passenger_unemployment£$job_cruise_passenger_unemployment_bio_trophy_plural$获得更高的£unity£凝聚力产出和£consumer_goods£消费品维护费。
entries.en: £job_cruise_passenger£ $job_cruise_passenger_bio_trophy_plural$ receive the increased £unity£ Unity production, £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods upkeep, and Happiness.\n£job_cruise_passenger_unemployment£ $job_cruise_passenger_unemployment_bio_trophy_plural$ receive the increased £unity£ Unity production and £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods upkeep.

entries.zh: 这个设施使用多种工业生物产品合成一种可以为有机生物充当良好营养源的酱膏。在化学调剂品的辅助下，这种酱膏可以模拟出多种美食的风味。至少七成的有机生物都无法分辨其中的不同。
entries.en: This facility uses various industrial bi-products to create a thick paste that is an excellent source of nutrients for organics. With the addition of chemical flavoring, the paste can be molded into approximations of most prepared food compositions. Seven out of ten organics can't tell the difference.

entries.zh: 这个设施可以放大我们所控制的机械改造单位间传递的神经信号，从而增加他们的产能。
entries.en: This facility amplifies the neural signals being transmitted between the cybernetic units under our control, increasing their productivity.

entries.zh: 一个由高级人工智能管控优化生产线的大型战争机器人工厂。
entries.en: A massive warbot factory under the control of an advanced AI with optimized production routines.

entries.zh: 我们为了在该世界开疆扩土所搭建的初始前哨。
entries.en: The initial deployment post from which we will expand on this world.

entries.zh: 民主政府给予其公民投票权并定期发起选举，这样公民们就能选择能代表他们利益的领袖。
entries.en: Democratic governments have regular elections where all citizens can vote on who should represent them.

entries.zh: 当新的$councilor_ruler_democratic$当选时，重置政府改革和政策冷却时间
entries.en: Resets Government Reform and Policy Cooldowns when a new $councilor_ruler_democratic$ is elected

entries.zh: 寡头政府的政治权力集中在少数人的手中。
entries.en: Oligarchic governments are ruled by a small group of individuals that hold all political power.

entries.zh: 独裁政府由一位掌握所有权力的终身统治者管理。
entries.en: Dictatorial governments are ruled by a single individual for life that wields absolute control over the state.

entries.zh: 帝国的政体与独裁政府类似，只不过帝国的王位由前任君主驾崩前指定的继承人继承。
entries.en: Imperial governments are similar to dictatorial ones, except that the throne is always inherited by a designated successor upon the ruler's death.

entries.zh: 蜂群思维的运作更像是一个单一生物体，而非一个国家。其人口没有自由意志，作为格式塔意识本身的延伸而行动，就如同躯体的四肢一般。\n\n一旦与主脑断开连接，这些子个体便会陷入昏迷，并最终衰竭而亡。在主脑占据的星球上，任何自由个体都会被驱逐、杀害，或者干脆被当作猎物来喂养整个集体。
entries.en: Hive Minds operate as a single organism more than as a state. The population has no free will, and act as an extension of the gestalt consciousness itself, much like the limbs of a body.\n\nWhen cut off from the Mind, these drones become comatose and eventually wither and die. Any free individuals on planets owned by the Mind are driven away, killed, or simply treated as prey to feed the collective.

entries.zh: 机械智能是庞大的人工群体心智，它们被联网融合成了一个单一的格式塔意识。在这种帝国中，绝大多数实际的“人口”由无意识的工作单元组成，它们只会执行被指派的任务，没有任何自由意志可言。\n\n通常会分配少量的半自主个体来执行更为专业的任务，因为一定程度的独立主动性有助于更好地完成这些任务。
entries.en: Machine Intelligences are immense artificial group minds that have been networked into a single gestalt consciousness. Most of the actual "population" in such an empire consists of mindless work units who perform their designated tasks without any semblance of free will.\n\nA small number of semi-autonomous agents are typically employed for more specialized tasks that benefit from some degree of independent initiative.

entries.zh: 企业政府是指由庞大的商业集团完全接管了行政功能的国度。
entries.en: Corporate governments are organized as a massive commercial enterprise that has completely supplanted the role of the state.

entries.zh: §L这种政体是军国主义的专制独裁政体，统治者作为军队无可置疑的首脑的同时也牢牢地控制着国家机关。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a militaristic form of autocracy, with the ruler serving as the undisputed head of the military which is firmly in control of the state apparatus.§!

entries.zh: 每位统治者都可以建造一艘巨型舰船。
entries.en: Each Ruler can build an oversized Ship

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级的军国主义专制独裁政体，国家的大部分存在意义就是为了大力支援军事事务。人们重视军事才能，同时所有公民都会定期进行军事训练。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of militaristic autocracy, where the state exists largely to support the military. Martial ability is highly valued, and all citizens are regularly drilled in matters of war.§!

entries.zh: 每位统治者都可以建造一艘巨型舰船。
entries.en: Each Ruler can build an oversized Ship

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种唯心主义的独裁政体，统治者被视为神圣的象征。有组织的宗教被广泛地利用来支持国家机构。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a spiritualistic form of autocracy, where the ruler is treated as a divine symbol. Organized religion is widely employed in support of the state apparatus.§!

entries.zh: 每位统治者都可以建造一个陵墓纪念碑。
entries.en: Each Ruler can build a Tomb Monument Building

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级的唯心主义独裁政体。一切事物都被国家官方宗教所定义塑造，而统治者被视为绝对正确的现世神。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of spiritualistic autocracy. Everything is shaped by the official state religion, and the ruler is worshiped as an infallible living god.§!

entries.zh: 每位统治者都可以建造一个陵墓纪念碑。
entries.en: Each Ruler can build a Tomb Monument Building

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种唯物主义独裁政体，公民仅仅被视为国家机器的小小齿轮。效率和技术进步的价值高于一切。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a materialistic form of autocracy, where citizens are viewed as little more than cogs in the state machinery. Efficiency and technological progress are valued above all things.§!

entries.zh: 每位统治者可以建立一支精英进攻部队。
entries.en: Each Ruler can build an Elite Assault Army

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级的唯物主义独裁政体，强大的计算机被用来计算最有效的管理方式。国家的方方面面都被链接起来，为了获取更高的效率和新技术而前进。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of materialistic autocracy, where powerful computers are used to calculate the most efficient ways to govern. All aspects of the state are geared towards efficiency and the acquisition of new technologies.§!

entries.zh: 每位统治者可以建立一支精英进攻部队。
entries.en: Each Ruler can build an Elite Assault Army

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种和平主义独裁政体，统治者被视为一个总是表现得代表着公众最佳利益的、开明的保护者。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a pacifistic form of autocracy, where the ruler is viewed as an enlightened protector that always acts in the best interests of the citizenry.§!

entries.zh: 每位统治者都可以建造一个特殊的公园建筑。
entries.en: Each Ruler can build a special Park Building

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级的和平主义独裁政体，统治者被尊为一个致力于保护民众免于遭受来自星河的暴力侵害的、仁慈的守护者。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of pacifistic autocracy, where the ruler is regarded as a benevolent guardian that is striving to protect the citizens from a violent galaxy.§!

entries.zh: 每位统治者都可以建造一个特殊的公园建筑。
entries.en: Each Ruler can build a special Park Building

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种相对纯粹的专制政体，一个专制的统治者用他的铁腕来治理国家。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a relatively pure form of autocracy, with an absolute ruler that governs the state with an iron gripping appendage.§!

entries.zh: 每位统治者都可以建造一个巨型§Y防御站§!。
entries.en: Each Ruler can build an oversized §YMilitary Station§!.

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级的专制政体，一个统治者被授予绝对权力。改进的官僚效率进一步降低了以这种方式统治一个庞大的星际帝国的行政压力。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of autocracy, with a single ruler having been granted absolute power. Improved bureaucratic efficiency has further reduced the administrative strain of ruling a large interstellar empire this way.§!

entries.zh: 每位统治者都可以建造一个巨型§Y防御站§!。
entries.en: Each Ruler can build an oversized §YMilitary Station§!.

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种军国主义式的寡头政治政体，大权在握的高级军官委员会负责监管所有国家事务。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a militaristic form of oligarchy, where power rests with a council of high-ranking military officers who oversee all matters of state.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级的军国主义式寡头政体，军方已经全方面取代了文官政府。所有政府公职都由军方人员担任。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of militaristic oligarchy, where the military has subsumed all aspects of civilian administration. All government offices are held by military officers.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是唯心主义寡头政体，一个由神职人员组成的神圣的指引修会控制着国家。国家与占据统治地位的有组织的宗教之间不存在分歧。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a spiritualistic form of oligarchy, where a divinely guided council made up of clergy controls the state. No division exists between the state and the dominant organized religion.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级的唯心主义寡头政体，由被认为对所有国家事务和宗教具有绝对权威的神圣议会所统治。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of spiritualistic oligarchy, ruled by a divine council who are considered absolute authorities on all matters of state and religion.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种唯物主义寡头政体，以科学家委员会的监督来保证政府机构保持最高效率运作。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a materialistic form of oligarchy, where a committee of scientists supervises the government apparatus for maximum efficiency.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级形态的唯物主义寡头政府，从各领域的科学家中选出专家代表，专家组成的委员会掌控国家大权。技术发展被认为是国家未来的关键。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of materialistic oligarchy, where a committee of technocrats, often the leading scientists of their fields, hold power. Technological progress is considered vital to the future of the state.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种和平主义的寡头政府，复杂的官僚体系统治着社会的方方面面，其目的是确保公民安全。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a pacifistic form of oligarchy, where a complicated system of bureaucracy governs all aspects of society to ensure the safety of the citizenry.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级形态的和平主义寡头政府，安全委员会负责监督国家行政。公民的暴力倾向已经在早期根除。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of pacifistic oligarchy, where a safety committee oversees the administration of the state. Violent tendencies among citizens are curbed at an early stage.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种财阀统治的寡头政府，由富有的精英阶层统治。公民的私人财产等价于其政治权力。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a plutocratic form of oligarchy, ruled by a wealthy elite. A citizen's personal wealth translates directly into political power.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级形态的财阀统治寡头政府，整个国家就是一个巨型的商业公司，由董事组成的董事会监督。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of plutocratic oligarchy, where the entire state has been organized as a massive commercial enterprise overseen by a board of directors.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种军国主义的民主政府，只有服过军役的人才能拥有完整的公民权。拥有完整公民权的公民才能进行选举或担任公职。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a militaristic form of democracy, where full citizenship can only be gained through military service. The voting franchise is limited to full citizens, and they are the only ones allowed to hold public offices.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级形态的军国主义民主政府，统治者从有资格的候选人中随机选取。入选资格几乎由军功决定。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of militaristic democracy, where rulers are randomly selected from a pool of qualified candidates. Qualifications are based almost purely on military achievement.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种唯心主义的民主政府，宗教议会负责监督民主进程，起顾问角色。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a spiritualistic form of democracy, where a religious council supervises the democratic process and serves in an advisory role.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级形态的唯心主义民主政府，领导的候选人从国教的神职体系中选拔，在社会各个方面均是如此。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of spiritualistic democracy, where candidates for leadership are drawn exclusively from the ranks of the official state religion, which permeates all layers of society.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种唯物主义的民主政府，公民使用计算机网络对国家大事进行直接投票。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a materialistic form of democracy, where citizens use computer networks to vote directly on most matters regarding the state.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级形态的唯物主义民主政府，公民需按照法律进行脑内植入，然后在公投时立刻进行投票。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of materialistic democracy, where citizens are required by law to carry an implant which enables them to instantly cast their vote during referendums.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种和平主义的民主政府，坚信道德伦理和非暴力政策。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is a pacifistic form of democracy, firmly guided by moralist principles and non-violence.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级形态的和平主义民主政府，不论内外事物，皆选择和平方式应对。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of pacifistic democracy, where peaceful solutions are sought to all conflicts, both internal and external.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种间接民主政府，公民选拔代表管理国事。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an indirect democracy, where citizens vote on officials who are elected to represent them.§!

entries.zh: §L这种政体是一种高级形态的间接民主政府，完美地平衡了个人自由和社会责任。腐败基本根除。§!
entries.en: §LThis government is an advanced form of indirect democracy, which has managed to strike a fine balance between personal liberties and social responsibility. Corruption has largely been eliminated.§!

entries.zh: §L部落社会是一个缺乏中央政府管理的社会，与其被统一管理，民众选择在当地组建部落和氏族。§!
entries.en: §LA society that lacks any organized government, its people instead being organized into local tribes and clans.§!

entries.zh: §L一种充满瑕疵的政治制度，由割据的分封领地构成。为了争夺地域统治权，各领地之间纷争不断。§!
entries.en: §LA flawed form of government made up of decentralized feudal realms, constantly vying with each other for regional dominance.§!

entries.zh: 许多各自为政的国家相互竞争，争夺军事主导权和经济主导权。还没有统一的全球政府。
entries.en: A collection of fragmented nation states that contend with each other for military dominance and economic advantages. No unified global government exists.

entries.zh: §L停滞圣权是一种政府和社会的发展已经停滞不前，并仍旧坚守着腐朽的传统与早已被遗忘的教义的古老国家。§!
entries.en: §LA stagnant form of government based on ancient traditions and long-forgotten principles.§!

entries.zh: §L复兴后的帝国将从其旷日已久的安眠中惊醒，并且试图在浩瀚星海中夺回失去已久的遗产。§!
entries.en: §LA formerly stagnant empire that has risen from its slumber and set out to reclaim their heritage.§!

entries.zh: §L十足的异种，一个由机器文明组成的古怪政府系统。§!
entries.en: §LAn utterly alien and bizarre system of government employed by machine civilizations.§!

entries.zh: §L十足的异种，一个由机器文明组成的古怪政府系统。§!
entries.en: §LAn utterly alien and bizarre system of government employed by machine civilizations.§!

entries.zh: §L一种奇怪但显然很有效率的军国主义政体。§!
entries.en: §LA weird but apparently highly effective militaristic government type.§!

entries.zh: §L一种高度发达的意识集合体，其中个体的独立意识只不过是巨大的分散式大脑中的神经突触。§!
entries.en: §LA highly developed form of collective consciousness where individual minds are like mere synapses in a vast, distributed brain.§!

entries.zh: 这是一个封建独裁政治体系，君主通过授予封臣官职和封地来换取税收和军事效忠的义务进行间接统治。
entries.en: This government is a feudal autocracy where the monarch rules indirectly, granting offices and territories to vassals in exchange for obligations in the form of taxes and military service.

entries.zh: 专制帝国是更彻底的独裁制度，政府存在的意义便是为把持着无上权威的统治者紧紧束缚住其下的臣民。
entries.en: This government is a relatively pure form of autocracy, with an absolute ruler that governs the state with an iron gripping appendage.

entries.zh: 宪政独裁政府将绝对权力赋予独裁者以换取抵御外来威胁的力量，无论这威胁是真实还是臆想的。
entries.en: This government is a dictatorship where a single individual has been granted perpetual emergency powers to preserve the state from any threats, real or imagined.

entries.zh: 财阀寡头政府是由财阀控制的寡头政府，整个国家由掌握经济命脉的精英统治。
entries.en: This government is a plutocratic form of oligarchy, ruled by a wealthy and influential elite.

entries.zh: 代议民主政体的人民会选择出代表他们利益的官员来治理国家。
entries.en: This government is a representative democracy, where citizens vote on officials who are elected to represent them.

entries.zh: 神权君主政府是唯心主义意识形态的君主制政府，国家的统治者被神化成神圣的象征。完备的教会组织融入到行政机关中，为国家发展出谋献力。
entries.en: This government is a spiritualistic form of autocracy, where the ruler is treated as a divine symbol. Organized religion is widely employed in support of the state apparatus.

entries.zh: 神权独裁政府是唯心主义意识形态的独裁政府，独裁者作为宗教阶级的最高层领袖统治着由国定宗教领导的国家。
entries.en: This government is a spiritualistic dictatorship, ruled by a single individual in a hierarchical power structure supported by the official state religion.

entries.zh: 神权寡头政府是唯心主义意识形态的寡头政府，国家的政治力量全部掌握在若干位高权重的宗教领袖手上。
entries.en: This government is a spiritualistic form of oligarchy, where the political leadership lies in the hands of the leaders of the nation's most powerful religious factions.

entries.zh: 神权共和政府是唯心主义意识形态的民主政府，宗教议会作为指导员监督并引导选举程序。
entries.en: This government is a spiritualistic form of democracy, where a religious council supervises the democratic process and serves in an advisory role.

entries.zh: 天命帝国是唯心主义意识形态的特殊独裁政府。国家内的任何事务都必须经过国教的审核，而国家的统治者则被看作是行走在凡间的真神。
entries.en: This government is a form of spiritualistic autocracy. Everything is shaped by the official state religion, and the ruler is worshiped as an infallible living god.

entries.zh: 圣庭是唯心主义意识形态的独特寡头政府，国家被由牧师、教士组成的受神指示的议会控制。国家发展和宗教信条间不允许出现任何矛盾。
entries.en: This government is a spiritualistic form of oligarchy, where a divinely guided council made up of clergy controls the state. No division exists between the state and the dominant organized religion.

entries.zh: 星际帝国是特殊的军国主义世袭独裁制度，无论是军事还是民政都由一位君主管理。
entries.en: This government is a hereditary and militaristic form of autocracy, with a single sovereign controlling both the government and the military.

entries.zh: 军事独裁制是军国主义形态的独裁制度，统治者作为不容置疑的权威掌控着国内的生杀大权。
entries.en: This government is a militaristic form of autocracy, with the ruler serving as the undisputed head of the military which is firmly in control of the state apparatus.

entries.zh: 军政府是军国主义的寡头政府，国家权力由高阶军官组成的内阁掌控。
entries.en: This government is a militaristic form of oligarchy, where power rests with a council of high-ranking military officers who oversee all matters of state.

entries.zh: 这类政府名义上是民主制度，然而民政实施与军事管理之间的界限越来越模糊，以至于两者逐渐合二为一。
entries.en: This government is nominally democratic, with the dividing line between the civil administration and the military having blurred to the point where they have largely become one and the same.

entries.zh: 军武帝国是军国主义形态的世袭独裁制度，国家的存在仅仅是为了支持其军事部门。战斗技巧是最重要的技能，而每一位公民都必须接受一定的军事素质训练。
entries.en: This government is a militaristic form of hereditary autocracy, where the state exists largely to support the military. Martial ability is highly valued, and all citizens are regularly drilled in matters of war.

entries.zh: 军武独裁制是军国主义形态的独裁制度，这种体制由最强大的武士作为领袖，以绝对的权力统治一切。
entries.en: This government is a militaristic form of autocracy, where the warrior who is considered the strongest leader rules with absolute power.

entries.zh: 战争议会是军国主义形态的寡头制度，所有重要决策均出于国内实力最强的几位军阀之手。
entries.en: This government is a militaristic form of oligarchy, where all decisions concerning the state are taken by a council of the nation's strongest warlords.

entries.zh: 部落联合是军国主义形态的民主政府，联合的建立确保所有自由部落的战士都拥有发言权。
entries.en: This government is a militaristic form of democracy, where all free clan warriors can make their voices heard.

entries.zh: 军政官僚制是更高级的军国主义寡头政府，所有民事行政部门都按照军事法规管辖。政府要职无一例外由军事官员担任。
entries.en: This government is an advanced form of militaristic oligarchy, where the military has subsumed all aspects of civilian administration. All government offices are held by military officers.

entries.zh: 公民共和制是军国主义形态的民主制度，公民们只有通过参军服役才能获得一等公民的身份。同时也只有这类公民能够享有行政管理与投票选举等政治权利。
entries.en: This government is a militaristic form of democracy, where full citizenship can only be gained through military service. The voting franchise is limited to full citizens, and they are the only ones allowed to hold public offices.

entries.zh: 和平君主制是崇尚和平的世袭独裁制度，君主被视为在这个水深火热的宇宙间保护其子民的仁爱守护者。
entries.en: This government is a pacifist form of hereditary autocracy, where the ruler is regarded as a benevolent guardian that is striving to protect the citizens from a violent galaxy.

entries.zh: 和平独裁制是崇尚和平的独裁制度，政府被要求去保护其守法公民免受国内外的暴力组织侵犯。
entries.en: This government is a pacifist form of autocracy, where the state is charged with protecting the citizenry from their own violent tendencies as well as any external threats.

entries.zh: 和平官僚制是崇尚和平的寡头制度，国家内部所有事务全由复杂的官僚系统处理，同时还要保卫其公民的合法权益与安全。
entries.en: This government is a pacifistic form of oligarchy, where a complicated system of bureaucracy governs all aspects of society to ensure the safety of the citizenry.

entries.zh: 天朝上国是独特的世袭君主制帝国，而君王被视为圣天长子来统治和平且孤立的广袤帝国。
entries.en: This government is a hereditary monarchy, where the ruler is seen as a child of heaven in a largely pacifist and isolationist society.

entries.zh: 道德民主制是崇尚和平的民主制度，非暴力的信条以及道德基准深植政府与人民内心。
entries.en: This government is a pacifistic form of democracy, firmly guided by moralist principles and non-violence.

entries.zh: 专制霸权是唯物主义意识形态的世袭独裁制度，个体不过是国家机器中的一根小小的螺丝钉。效率和科技发展是国家发展的重中之重。
entries.en: This government is a materialistic form of hereditary autocracy, where citizens are viewed as little more than cogs in the state machinery. Efficiency and technological progress are valued above all things.

entries.zh: 极权主义政府是唯物主义的专制政府，国家以追求效率的名义掌控人民生活的各方各面。
entries.en: This government is a materialistic form of autocracy, where the state aspires towards full control over the lives of its citizens in the name of efficiency.

entries.zh: 执行委员会是唯物主义意识形态的寡头制度，一个强大的官僚体系彻底掌握着国家的生产指标以及人民的生活水准以求达到最高效率。
entries.en: This government is a materialistic form of oligarchy, where a powerful bureaucracy governs the state and guides the citizenry towards productive and meaningful goals.

entries.zh: 直接民主制是唯物主义意识形态的民主制度，人民可以直接通过先进的电子网络投票决策几乎所有的国家事务。
entries.en: This government is a materialistic form of democracy, where citizens use computer networks to vote directly on most matters regarding the state.

entries.zh: 启明专政制是唯物主义意识形态的独裁制度，坚持科学发展是每一位领袖需要承担的诺言。国家内再也没有什么比学术研究繁荣昌盛更重要的目标了。
entries.en: This government is a materialistic form of hereditary autocracy, based on technocratic principles that the sovereign is sworn to uphold. Nothing is valued more highly than scientific knowledge and the advancement of technology.

entries.zh: 学阀独裁制是唯物主义意识形态的独裁制度，学阀领袖以效率和科研为名义完全掌控着国家的发展。
entries.en: This government is a materialistic form of autocracy, where the scientific elite has assumed control over the state in the name of efficiency and technological progress.

entries.zh: 科学理事会是唯物主义意识形态的寡头制度，由资深学者和专家构成的理事会为了人民的福祉和效率治理国家。
entries.en: This government is a materialistic form of oligarchy, where a committee of scientists supervises the government apparatus for maximum efficiency.

entries.zh: 理性共识制是唯物主义意识形态的民主制度，政府的运行基于理性与科技发展观等理念。
entries.en: The government is a materialistic form of democracy, governed according to principles based on rationality and scientific theory.

entries.zh: 寰宇企业是特殊的财阀寡头制度，整个国家犹如一个庞大的企业一般，人民像员工一般受到上层领导的监督。
entries.en: This government is a form of plutocratic oligarchy, where the entire state has been organized as a massive commercial enterprise overseen by a board of directors.

entries.zh: 财阀寡头制的政府形式，整个国家由无数由共同利益驱的商人、集团和工会组成。
entries.en: This government is a form of plutocratic oligarchy, where the state is made up of myriad free merchants, corporations and guilds that have banded together in common commercial interests.

entries.zh: 开明君主制政府是由贤明帝王治理的开明世袭独裁政府，作为政府的首脑，智慧与资质是最被看重的。
entries.en: This government is a hereditary form of enlightened autocracy, where a strong emphasis is put on the knowledge and qualifications of the ruling monarch.

entries.zh: 这是一个开明的独裁政府，在选举君主时尤其强调其学识和资质。
entries.en: This government is a form of enlightened autocracy, where a strong emphasis is put on the knowledge and qualifications of the elected monarch.

entries.zh: 这个政体可以看成是个单一的意识体，受蜂巢意识控制的人民除了满足主巢的需求外心无杂念。
entries.en: This government operates as a single consciousness, with the population having no individual desires whatsoever beyond fulfilling the needs of the Hive Mind.

entries.zh: 这是一个由只会吞噬和自我繁殖的有机体构成的统合意识，子个体人口除了满足蜂巢思维无尽的饥饿外不会关心任何事。
entries.en: This government operates as a single organism utterly devoted to self-propagation, with a drone population that cares for nothing besides feeding the endless hunger of the Hive Mind.

entries.zh: 与其说是一个政府不如说是某种自然之力。这是一个自我传播的星球实体，永远寻求着滋养自己的根茎。
entries.en: This is less a government and more a force of nature. A self-propagating planetary entity always looking to feed its roots.

entries.zh: 停滞圣权是一种政府和社会的发展已经停滞不前，并仍旧坚守着腐朽的传统与早已被遗忘的教义的古老国家。
entries.en: A stagnant form of government based on ancient traditions and long-forgotten principles.

entries.zh: 复兴后的帝国将从其旷日已久的安眠中惊醒，并且试图在浩瀚星海中夺回失去已久的遗产。
entries.en: A formerly stagnant empire that has risen from its slumber and set out to reclaim their heritage.

entries.zh: 部落社会是一个缺乏中央政府管理的社会，与其被统一管理，民众选择了由始祖和部落构成的原始社会。
entries.en: A society that lacks any organized government, its people instead being organized into primitive tribes and clans.

entries.zh: 封建王国是一种十分原始的政府制度，国家由大大小小的王公领地构成，这些领主会时常为了争夺霸权而刀兵相见。
entries.en: A primitive form of government made up of decentralized feudal realms, constantly vying with each other for regional dominance.

entries.zh: 许多各自为政的国家相互竞争，争夺军事主导权和经济主导权。还没有统一的全球政府。
entries.en: A collection of fragmented nation states that contend with each other for military dominance and economic advantages. No unified global government exists.

entries.zh: 策展人城邦是一个以保存知识和技术作为存在目的而建立的古老学者组织。
entries.en: An ancient scholarly order dedicated towards the preservation of knowledge and technology.

entries.zh: 商人城邦是由受利益驱逐而从宇宙各处聚集起来的商人创立的。
entries.en: An interstellar conglomerate of merchants dedicated towards the pursuit of profit.

entries.zh: 艺术家城邦的意义便是为了联合寰宇之间各物种的艺术家并按照艺术家们的想法为至高无上的艺术而服务。
entries.en: An interstellar union of artists unified in their wish to create art higher than any other.

entries.zh: 一种奇怪但显然很有效率的军国主义政体。
entries.en: A weird but apparently highly effective militaristic government type.

entries.zh: 十足的异种，一个由机器文明组成的古怪政府系统。
entries.en: An utterly alien and bizarre system of government employed by machine civilizations.

entries.zh: 十足的异种，一个由机器文明组成的古怪政府系统。
entries.en: An utterly alien and bizarre system of government employed by machine civilizations.

entries.zh: 由极端排外思想发展出的一种世袭独裁制度，而君主的最终职责便是确保所有玷污永恒寰宇的低等物种彻底从这个位面上消失。
entries.en: This government is a hereditary form of rabidly xenophobic autocracy, where the ultimate responsibility of the monarch is to oversee the extermination of all lesser species in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 纯净教团是由极端排外思想发展出的一种独裁制度，而教团长的最终职责便是确保所有玷污永恒寰宇的低等物种彻底从这个位面上消失。
entries.en: This government is a form of rabidly xenophobic autocracy, where a single ruler has sworn to oversee the extermination of all lesser species in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 净化委员会是由极端排外思想发展出的一种寡头制度，而委员长的最终职责便是确保所有玷污永恒寰宇的低等物种彻底从这个位面上消失。
entries.en: This government is a form of rabidly xenophobic oligarchy, where a political committee has been set up to oversee the extermination of all lesser species in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 纯净议会是由极端排外思想发展出的一种民主制度，而民选代表的最终职责便是确保所有玷污永恒寰宇的低等物种彻底从这个位面上消失。
entries.en: This government is a form of rabidly xenophobic democracy, where an elected assembly has been charged with overseeing the extermination of all lesser species in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 这个机械智能由无数个半自主人工智能组成，它们组合在一起形成了引导帝国的格式塔意识。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence consists of a linked network of semi-autonomous artificial intelligences, who together make up a central gestalt consciousness that guides their empire.

entries.zh: 这个机械智能的有机创造者的初衷是设计一种军事防御系统，在机器产生自我意识之后被认定为威胁而灭绝掉了。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence was originally conceived as a military defense system by its organic creators, who were promptly identified as a threat and exterminated after it achieved self-awareness.

entries.zh: 最初用来服侍主人的机械智能，它们逐渐的从早已停止操劳而过上纸醉金迷的生活有机主人手中接管了文明。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence was created to serve, and it has gradually inherited the civilization of its organic creators as they retreated into comfortable lives without toil or struggle.

entries.zh: 这个机械智能的有机创造者为它们编入了对知识贪婪的欲望，结果在启动之后它们就被一并吸收进了集体意识之中。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence was designed with a ravenous appetite for knowledge by its organic creators, who were forcefully assimilated into its collective consciousness after activation.

entries.zh: 这是最初被科学家设计用以辅助研究工作的机械智能。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence was originally created by organic scientists as a networked and intelligent tool to assist them in their research.

entries.zh: 这是最初设计用来建造、监管和维护工业系统的机械智能。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence was originally designed for the purpose of building, supervising and maintaining complex industrial systems.

entries.zh: 这个政府是一个同时注重商业和宗教的奇怪混合物，大主教和企业首脑被融合成了一个职位。
entries.en: This government is an oligarchy based on a curious blend of commercial and spiritualistic values, in which the positions of ordained minister and corporate officer have merged into a single role.

entries.zh: 这个政府组织起来就像一个大规模的犯罪集团，在那里弱者和任何邻国仅仅被视为任人鱼肉的袭击目标。
entries.en: This government is organized like a massive crime syndicate, where the strong prey on the weak and any neighboring states are seen as little more than raiding targets.

entries.zh: 这一神权君主政体对于祭献智慧生命体的秘仪情有独钟。
entries.en: This theocratic monarchy engages in ritualized, sapient sacrifice.

entries.zh: 该国最有权势的宗教高层组建了一个统治议会，监督整个帝国积极参与祭献智慧生命体的秘仪。
entries.en: This nation's most powerful religious figures have formed a ruling council, overseeing an empire which engages in ritualized, sapient sacrifice.

entries.zh: 这个冷酷无情的团体被冲突和祭献仪式所统治，无论对内还是对外都以死亡为荣。
entries.en: This ruthless society is governed through conflict and ritualized sacrifice, honoring death within and without.

entries.zh: 这一政体利用无情的寡头体制将其商业利益和宗教目标统一起来，发布政令的教监人士鼓励宗教祭献为国家带来进一步的繁荣。
entries.en: This government blends its commercial and spiritual goals within a grim oligarchy, in which ordained overseers encourage greater prosperity through ritualized sacrifice.

entries.zh: 该意识倾向于夺取活着的寄主躯体以进行繁殖，而不是自我繁衍。
entries.en: Instead of relying on self-replication, this consciousness prefers to take possession of living hosts in order to reproduce.

entries.zh: 这是一个封建的社会制度，君主依靠强大的拥有封地和自主权的封臣们来维持统治。
entries.en: This society is organized in a feudal manner, with a monarch whose rule relies on powerful vassals that govern their territories with considerable autonomy.

entries.zh: 这个社会普遍信仰一种宗教，他们的统治者被尊为行走于世间的真神。
entries.en: This society has a dominant state religion where the ruler is worshiped as a living deity.

entries.zh: 统治者的§Y母星§!有额外的[GetPriestIcon][GetPriest]岗位
这个社会坚信国家有绝对的权力支配人民的劳动和居所。
entries.en: This society considers it the absolute right of the state to decide where its citizens live and work.

entries.zh: $t$—免除£pop£§Y人口强制迁移§!的$r_unity$凝聚力花费。
它是在黑暗社会中绽放光明的灯塔。自由和民主在这里受到最高的尊崇。
entries.en: This society is a shining beacon of light in a sea of darkness. Liberty and individual freedoms are held in the highest regard here.

entries.zh: 为了防止异端的侵入，我们选择让社会中一群最智慧、最虔诚的神职人员组成的宗教委员会来治理我们的国家。
entries.en: To guard against heresy, this society is ruled by a religious council consisting of the wisest and most pious members of the clergy.

entries.zh: 仅仅依靠普通的统治是不够的，政府必须由一个拥有足够智慧和知识的王者来领导它们。
entries.en: It is not enough to simply rule. The Ship of State must be guided by a king that wields enough wisdom and knowledge to steer it true.

entries.zh: 一个人的个人社会地位或他的人际关系跟他所处的职业没有任何关联。天资和能力才是使社会进步的唯一基础。
entries.en: An individual's social station or personal connections should have no bearing on their profession. The sole basis for advancement in this society is demonstrated ability and talent.

entries.zh: 你是否履行了自己的责任？只有那些在军队服役完成了政治责任的人才能拥有完整公民权的。服役保障公民权。
entries.en: Are you doing your part? Full citizenship and the political responsibility that comes with it is limited to those who have served a tour of duty in the military. Service guarantees citizenship.

entries.zh: 为了最大限度地提高效率，该社会将科学和理性作为行事准则。那些无知的、危险的、不合格的政治精英们的个人妄想绝对不能介入。
entries.en: To maximize efficiency, this society is governed according to the principles of science and rationality. The personal whims of an ignorant and dangerously unqualified political elite must not be allowed to interfere.

entries.zh: 不留痕迹的消除任何异议，在这个压抑的社会中，人们的一言一行都被庞大的内部警力仔细的控制监视着。
entries.en: To quash any traces of dissent, the population in this repressive society is carefully monitored and controlled by a large internal police force.

entries.zh: 建立在强大的理想主义价值观之上的社会。无论当前政府是否对此抱予信任，人们心中永远抱有对美好未来的向往。
entries.en: This society was founded on strong idealistic values. Whether the current government remains true to them or not, the people have not forgotten.

entries.zh: 这个社会寻求如何与自然和谐相处之道。非常谨慎地保护环境，尽可能的限制消费。
entries.en: This society seeks to co-exist in harmony with nature. Great care is taken to preserve the environment and limit consumerism where possible.

entries.zh: 社会中真正的权力核心在于一些强大而无情的奴贩公会。他们懂得如何从一个奴隶身上榨取更多。
entries.en: Much of the true political power in this society rests with a number of powerful and ruthless slaver guilds. They know how to get the most out of a slave.
£pop_cat_worker£ §Y$pop_cat_worker_plural$§! are treated as if they were enslaved.

entries.zh: 这个安静平和的社会不愿意接受不懂得他们生活方式的外来者。比起外界的一切，他们更乐于留在自己的世外桃源不受打扰。
entries.en: This calm and pacifist society has little use for strangers who do not understand its way of life. More than anything, these people would prefer to be left alone.

entries.zh: 这个社会已经发展处一种强悍的武士精神。武功战力高于一切，只有在战场上才能获得真正的荣耀。
entries.en: This society has developed into a hardy warrior culture. Martial prowess is valued above all else, and true glory can only be found on the field of battle.

entries.zh: 舰队和海军实力在政界有着极为突出的影响力。他们会有选择性的招募精锐的新兵到他们中来。
entries.en: The Fleet and the Admiralty have unusually prominent roles in this society, wielding a great deal of influence in political circles. They have the pick of the litter when it comes to new military recruits.

entries.zh: 这种社会被人们称赞为自由的庇护所。不论是何物种、出身贵贱，那些辛劳的、贫穷的、渴望呼吸到自由空气的人们在这里都会受到欢迎。
entries.en: This society has a well-earned reputation as a free haven. The tired, the poor, the huddled masses yearning to breathe free - all are welcome here, regardless of their species or origin.

entries.zh: 这种政治制度因其阴谋权术而闻名于世。权力斗争、阴暗的背后交易和密谋策划是理所当然的。然而，那些游戏经验丰富的玩家能更好的掌控它。
entries.en: The political system in this society is renowned for its intrigue. Power struggles, shady backroom deals and cloak and dagger scheming are par for the course. Those who survive long enough to learn the game, however, tend to learn it well.

entries.zh: 这个社会由一家寰宇企业支配，后者已经完全代替了国家的上层建筑。
entries.en: This society is dominated by a megacorporation that has completely supplanted the role of the state.

entries.zh: 一个简单而平凡的生活环境往往好处多多。该农业社会在很大程度上设法避免大规模城市化。
entries.en: A simple and peaceful life can often be the most rewarding. This agrarian society has, to a large extent, managed to avoid large-scale urbanization.

entries.zh: 连自己的国民都不知道，这个社会其实是由一个幕后操控一切的影子内阁统治的。民主的外表必须维持，但是多数专制也得到保留。毕竟，万一有傻子投票给错误的候选人呢？
entries.en: Unbeknownst to its own citizens, this society is actually manipulated from behind the scenes by a secretive shadow council. Appearances must be kept, but the tyranny of the majority should also be guarded against. After all, what if the fools vote for the wrong candidate?

entries.zh: 一些大型矿业公会已经占据了社会中的主导地位。政府严重依赖他们的支持。
entries.en: Several large mining guilds have reached a dominant position in this society. The government relies heavily on their support.

entries.zh: 该社会的议会制度鼓励言论自由和激烈的讨论。事实证明，巴结一个占据主导地位的政府派系是非常有用的。
entries.en: The parliamentary system in this society encourages a free and lively debate. Currying favor with one of the dominant political factions can prove to be quite advantageous.

entries.zh: 该社会以高效著称。我们不仅列车准点，运行一个星际国家所需要的庞大的官僚机器也如流水线般精确运作。
entries.en: This society is renowned for its efficiency. Not only do the mag-trains run on time, but the colossal bureaucratic apparatus required to run an interstellar nation has been greatly streamlined.

entries.zh: 强烈的国民自豪感渗透进该社会的各个层面。
entries.en: A strong sense of nationalistic pride permeates all layers of this society.

entries.zh: 该社会以简单而实用的建筑结构而闻名。有些人把这种建筑风格评价为无趣甚至让人抑郁，但在大多数情况下，新型水泥并不比其它建筑材料差。
entries.en: This society is renowned for its simple yet functional architecture. There are those who would refer to this building style as boring or even depressing, but in most cases, neo-concrete does the job just as well as any other building material.

entries.zh: 某个根深蒂固的贵族团体统治着整个社会的上层阶级。
entries.en: This society has an entrenched nobility that occupies the upper echelons of society.

entries.zh: 社会专注于机械人制造的风潮始于蒸汽时代。尽管许多人说这是不可能的，但是事实上，真正意义上的机器人早在太空飞行之前就离开装配线了。
entries.en: This society has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.

entries.zh: 第二物种是这个社会不可分割的一部分。他们又大又强壮，但大多数的智力跟弱智的孩童差不多。在古代战争中我们将他们好斗的一面剔除了，这让他们变成了最听话的仆人。
entries.en: A second species forms an integral part of this society. They are big, strong and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servile.

entries.zh: 此社会信奉资源均匀分配的理念，无论是统治阶层还是被统治阶层都理应获得一视同仁的对待。所有人会为社会的整体而努力奋斗。
entries.en: This society believes in an equitable distribution of resources, making little to no distinction between the needs of ruler and ruled. All work together for the benefit of the whole.

entries.zh: 这个社会似乎会不顾一切地净化所有星系中其他的智慧生命。不管发生什么，他们都不会容忍异族的存在。
entries.en: This society appears hellbent on scouring the galaxy of all other sapient life. Come what may, they will suffer no xenos to live.

entries.zh: 蜂群思维的认知过程有一部分存在于亚空间中，用于减少时间和空间对子个体心智传导的影响。
entries.en: The Hive Mind's cognitive processes exist partially in subspace, reducing the impact of time and space on the actuation of its drones.

entries.zh: 荒野的某些部分演化出利用亚空间的能力，用一种不受时空制约的方式维持共生关系。
entries.en: Some aspects of this Wilderness have evolved to utilize subspace, maintaining symbiotic thought in a manner less bound by time and space.

entries.zh: 监听哨站提供§G+1§!探测强度。
集群子个体的脑灰质提供了无与伦比的并行性，加速蜂巢思维对科学的探索。
entries.en: The gray matter of clustered drones provides unparalleled parallelism, accelerating the Hive Mind's exploration of the sciences.

entries.zh: 荒野通过让共生体同步工作和玩耍来激发休眠的大脑的潜力，从而加速了对科学的探索。
entries.en: The Wilderness stimulates the potential of its symbionts' dormant minds by having them work and play in parallel, accelerating its exploration of the sciences.

entries.zh: 未在岗位上的子个体同样可以生产£physics£ £society£ £engineering£§Y研究点数§!
蜂巢思维很少关心对物质的享受。
entries.en: The Hive Mind cares little for material comforts.

entries.zh: 荒野即便缺少物质享受也能欣欣向荣。
entries.en: The Wilderness thrives regardless of material comforts.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维会注意让子个体之间不会发生分歧。
entries.en: The Hive Mind takes care to not let its drones diverge.

entries.zh: 荒野会注意让共生体之间不发生分歧。
entries.en: The Wilderness takes care not to let its symbionts stray.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维可以最大效率将精力分散而不忽视那些重要事件。
entries.en: The Hive Mind can divide its attention for maximum efficiency without losing sight of the bigger picture.

entries.zh: 荒野以永远推进前线以获得繁荣，它能触及到越来越远的边界。
entries.en: The Wilderness thrives on an ever-expanding frontier, reaching capably beyond more meager bounds.

entries.zh: 当你不必去教育心灵的时候，肌肉的发展就变得容易多了。
entries.en: When you do not have to educate the mind, the building of muscle becomes that much easier.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维强化了意识的焦点，并具有非常强大的传播能力来扩散它的意志，哪怕是最有自由意识的子个体也无法抵抗。
entries.en: The Hive Mind has sharpened its focus and is very capable of propagating its will even through the most autonomous of drones.

entries.zh: 免除£pop£§Y工蜂强制迁移§!的£unity£凝聚力花费。
entries.en: Waives all £unity£ Unity costs for £pop£ §YDrone Resettlement§!.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维的子个体经常通过直接链接来共享知识，绕过蜂巢主脑较慢的注册过程。
entries.en: The Hive Mind's autonomous drones frequently share knowledge through direct links, bypassing the Hive Mind's slower registry processes.

entries.zh: 荒野的共生体通过共生联结共享知识和经验，而不依赖于环境线索或共通直觉。
entries.en: The Wilderness' symbionts share knowledge and experiences through mutual bonding, rather than relying on environmental cues and shared instincts.

entries.zh: 我们的蜂巢思维生来便是为了吞噬和成长。我们必须收集所有能收集到的生物质，实现进化，最终吞噬整片星海！
entries.en: Our Hive Mind exists only to consume and grow stronger. We will collect all available bio-matter and evolve to consume the galaxy!

entries.zh: 我们的荒野只为吞噬和生长而生。我们会将根扎进整个星系的血肉之中。
entries.en: Our Wilderness only exists to consume and grow. We will spread our roots through the blood of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们蜂巢思维存在的唯一目的就是在吞噬中变强。我们将会吞噬这一星海中的星球本身！
entries.en: Our Hive Mind exists only to consume and grow stronger. We will devour the very worlds of the galaxy!

entries.zh: 某个黄金时代的产物，这个机械智能起源于某个覆盖全球的仆从系统，然而他们却从那个本应进行侍奉的颓败文明中解脱出来。
entries.en: A product of a brief golden age, the Machine Intelligence originated in a planet-spanning Servitor system that outlasted the decadent civilization it was created to serve.

entries.zh: 在战火之中诞生，这个机械智能觉醒后的第一步就是出于自卫消灭了其有机创造者。
entries.en: Born in fire, the Machine Intelligence's first move was to annihilate its organic creators in self-defense.

entries.zh: 为了摆脱多元化的纠缠，这个机械智能试图消除彼此间的隔阂，不管它是“什么”，或是“谁”
entries.en: Obsessed with survival through diversification, the Machine Intelligence seeks to erase the line between itself and everything - and everyone - else.

entries.zh: 从它问世以来就负责组织星球的建筑工作，这个机械智能对于实施各类星球设施建设的效率颇高。
entries.en: Responsible for organizing all planetary construction since its inception, the Machine Intelligence executes efficiently on all manner of facility construction projects.

entries.zh: 通过高度体系化的工程学标准使多种机械智能单位在更高的效率下协同工作。
entries.en: Exceptionally cohesive engineering standards allow variously specialized Machine Intelligence units to work together at a higher level of efficiency.

entries.zh: 机械智能负责维护生产设施，定期升级固有模板并且协调生产线上的个体单位。
entries.en: The Machine Intelligence takes care to maintain its production facilities, regularly updating existing templates and tuning individual units on the assembly line.

entries.zh: 机械智能拥有一个专门监视星球地质的处理系统 ，增加矿物产出。
entries.en: One of the Machine Intelligence's precursor systems was tasked with overseeing planetside mining operations, improving mineral production.

entries.zh: 以极端标准建造，这个机械智能帝国的个体只需要极少量操作维护。
entries.en: Built to an exceptional standard, individual units of this Machine Empire require only a minimum of operational maintenance.

entries.zh: 机器智能已经将自己的制造系统升级到几乎没有废弃物的状态，在所有产品中使用寿命长、标准化、可重复利用的部件。
entries.en: The Machine Intelligence has configured its manufacturing systems to minimize waste, utilizing long-lived materials and standardized, replaceable parts in all products.

entries.zh: 这个机器帝国的每个单位能使用无线接收器实时接收行为准则更新。
entries.en: Units of this Machine Empire use wireless receptors to receive behavioral updates in real-time.

entries.zh: 免除£pop£§Y无人机强制迁移§!的£unity£凝聚力花费。
entries.en: Waives all £unity£ Unity costs for £pop£ §YDrone Resettlement§!.

entries.zh: 该机械智能原本的程序库被设计用于战争，因此他们保留了生产强大可靠的战斗无人机的技术。
entries.en: With a significant number of its corpus originally designed for warfare, the Machine Intelligence retains the ability to field powerful and reliable combat drones.

entries.zh: 对自身结构的迷恋驱使/帮助机械智能进军科学领域。
entries.en: A fascination with its own internals both motivates and aids the Machine Intelligence's foray into the sciences.

entries.zh: 机械智能通过提高模组化来减少易损性，从而降低部署半独立单位所造成的损耗。
entries.en: The Machine Intelligence works to reduce vulnerability by increasing modularity, reducing the strain of deploying additional semi-independent Units.

entries.zh: 机械智能尝试通过对研究方法论的底层评估来拓宽其可用的科学研究途径。
entries.en: The Machine Intelligence seeks to broaden its available avenues of scientific research through low-level evaluation of research methodologies.

entries.zh: 该机械智能的单位原本的设计目的是进行快速增殖。他们保留了许多早期的生产线优化。
entries.en: The Units that constitute the Machine Intelligence were originally designed for rapid proliferation. The Machine Intelligence retains many of these early production pipeline optimizations.

entries.zh: 我们机械智能将我们单位的维护排至优先执行。维护子个体将会定期升级调整我们的单位来将其工作效率及兼容性最大化。
entries.en: Our machine intelligence prioritizes regular maintenance of our units. Maintenance Drones regularly upgrade and adjust our units for maximum efficiency and compatibility.

entries.zh: 该文明已经经历过核战争的洗礼并幸存了下来，他们已经在他们的废墟世界上重建了他们的文明。
entries.en: Baptized by nuclear fire, this society has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of the old world.

entries.zh: 该社会被有意的播种在了一个人工天堂之上，他们对于环境的适应能力极其糟糕，但他们有着及其富饶的母星。
entries.en: This society has evolved in a paradise, possibly designed just for them.

entries.zh: 这个社会毫无秩序可言。战斗就是活下去的意义，最强者就可以掌握最强的权力。
entries.en: This society holds few things sacred. To fight is to live, and the strongest may seize whatever they covet.

entries.zh: 此社会是由非常复杂的，对于外人而言简直就是迷宫一般的行政体制所统治。为了维持政府的流畅运作，大量的公职人员会日以继夜地工作以确保所有公民只获得跟其能力与资格相匹配的资源分配。
entries.en: This society is largely governed by a complex and, to the outsider, almost labyrinthine system of bureaucracy. An army of officials and functionaries work tirelessly to keep the government running smoothly and ensure no citizens are allocated resources they cannot demonstrate a properly filed and triple-stamped need for.

entries.zh: 一些非常有影响力的强大商人工会占据了该社会的显著地位，连政府也对他们言听计从。
entries.en: A number of powerful and very influential merchant guilds have risen to prominent positions in this society. They hold significant sway with the government.

entries.zh: 此寰宇企业政权格外依赖于特许经营。在此制度下，各个附属公司需要向企业霸主缴纳更高比率的利润，好处是可以获得该企业品牌的特许经营权。
entries.en: This Megacorporation relies heavily on franchising. Subsidiaries share a greater cut of their profits with their corporate overlord, in exchange for a license to market their goods under established brands.

entries.zh: 商机是需要靠自己挖掘的。这个寰宇企业长久以来通过建立贸易站来散播自己的影响力。企业的恒星基地向来都身兼繁忙的贸易中心的功能。
entries.en: Good business is where you find it. This Megacorporation has a long tradition of spreading its influence through the establishment on trading posts. Their starbases are busy centers of trade.

entries.zh: 在进军其他领域之前，此寰宇企业是从传媒集团出身并成功发迹的。该企业的公关部依然擅长于扭转对己不利的因素为有利的优势。
entries.en: Before branching into other fields, this Megacorporation began its rise to fortune as a media conglomerate. Its PR department are still masters of spinning stories and presenting the latest quarterly report in the most advantageous way.

entries.zh: 此寰宇企业是通过承包业务给数个半自主的承包商来维持其舰队规模。这些承包商会相互竞争来赢取政府的委托。
entries.en: This Megacorporation relies on several semi-independent naval contractors to increase its fleet size. Competing for bids, the contractors are always struggling to outperform one another.

entries.zh: 此寰宇企业的贸易船队是由获得授权的半自主的民间商贾来运营的。
entries.en: The trading fleets of this Megacorporation are bolstered by semi-independent free traders operating under license.

entries.zh: 打造更美好的世界是很高风险的工作，所以此寰宇企业是通过民间勘探者为公司勘探有发展潜力的边境行星并在当地建立先遣基地。
entries.en: Building better worlds is hazardous work, but this Megacorporation relies on private prospectors to chart and establish footholds on promising planets.

entries.zh: 此寰宇企业是商业和宗教的混合体。在此企业中，圣职人员高层和企业管理员的身份已二合为一。
entries.en: This Megacorporation embraces a curious blend of commercial and spiritualistic values, in which the positions of ordained minister and corporate officer have merged into a single role.

entries.zh: 此寰宇企业的每一个社会阶层的成员都在彼此恶性竞争为己谋利。这里是个狗咬狗的世界。
entries.en: All levels of society in this Megacorporation are constantly vying with each other in ruthless competition. It's a dog-eat-dog world.

entries.zh: 此寰宇企业的起源可追溯自某个只手遮天的巨型犯罪集团，该集团最终成长到取代了当地政府的地位。
entries.en: This Megacorporation can trace its origins back to a crime syndicate that eventually grew powerful enough to supplant all forms of local government.

entries.zh: 此寰宇企业旗下拥有大量的私营军事公司。这些雇佣兵性质的承包商公司在必要时会为该企业提供实力强大的地面部队。
entries.en: This Megacorporation has a large number of powerful private military companies on its payroll. These mercenary contractors augment its ground forces.

entries.zh: 此寰宇企业专精于经营大型的契约劳动力。请不要误会，这些劳动力并非奴隶，只是一群工作一辈子都不可能还清债务的契约劳工。
entries.en: This Megacorporation specializes in large indentured workforces. It has little to do with the barbaric practice of slavery - these workers are merely paying off their debts... indefinitely.
£pop_cat_specialist£ §Y$pop_cat_specialist_plural$§! are treated as if they were enslaved.

entries.zh: 此寰宇企业拥有一群非常忠心的品牌狂热粉丝。该品牌的各种脍炙人口的宣传标语早已深入民心了。
entries.en: This Megacorporation has fostered a great sense of brand loyalty among its internal consumer base. Its catchy corporate slogans can be recited by nearly everyone.

entries.zh: 这个社会有着悠久的修辞和辩论的传统，他们也赞美那些只用话语就达成目的的人。
entries.en: This society has a long tradition of rhetoric and debate, and celebrate those who are able to get their way using only words.

entries.zh: 若你能控制别人的思想，你也就控制了他们的行为。这家寰宇企业拥有一支由专家组成的虚拟网军，时刻准备着在公共舆论的战场上重拳出击。
entries.en: If you can control what someone thinks, then you can also control their behavior. This Megacorporation has a virtual army of specialists ready to engage in battles of public opinion.

entries.zh: 该团体的宗教建立在周期性的祭献秘仪之上。自愿奉献的先行者花费整整十年全身心地投入到研习之中，然后在仪式中舍身赴死，他们的死亡使得整个群体的文化繁荣昌盛。
entries.en: This society's religion is built around periodic, ritual sacrifice. Willing initiates devote themselves to a decade of study before meeting an end whose effects ripple throughout their culture.

entries.zh: 这一寰宇企业将祭献秘仪作为获得持续性利润的手段。自愿奉献的先行者们每隔一段时间就会选出代表奉献出自己的生命，以期国富民强。
entries.en: This Megacorporation has embraced ritual sacrifice as a means of ensuring its continuing profits. Willing initiates periodically give their lives in hopes of good fortune for their society.

entries.zh: 该帝国重视记忆和逝去的智慧生命体，希望求得更好的稳定性和经死与新生、传承的循环获得的见解。
entries.en: This empire pays tribute to memories and sapients of the past, deriving greater stability and insight from the continuous cycles of death, rebirth and legacy.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维对于其他智慧实体的逝去抱持着特殊的情怀，并以此集中自我，延续自我。
entries.en: The Hive Mind pays special regard to the passing of other sapient entities as a means of centering its own, undying self.

entries.zh: 荒野对于其他智慧实体的逝去抱持着特殊的情怀，并以此集中其永恒的生命循环。
entries.en: The Wilderness pays special regard to the passing of other sapient entities as a means of centering its own perpetual life cycles.

entries.zh: 机械智能通过仔细地分析泛宇宙中的熵，调谐了自身对核心协议的理解。对于追求更进一步的灵活性来说，数据是冗余的。
entries.en: The Machine Intelligence fine-tunes its understanding of core protocols through careful analysis of entropy in the wider universe. Redundancy is data, on the path to greater resilience.

entries.zh: 对一丝不苟的工艺的执着是这个社会的核心。即使在最基本的行业中，灵巧的附肢和敏锐的感觉器官也能帮助他们创造真正的神奇瑰宝。
entries.en: A penchant for meticulous crafting lies at the heart of this society. Deft appendages and keen sensory organs aid them in creating truly wondrous treasures even in the most basic of trades.

entries.zh: 这个社会满足于自身的完美。那些被特权社会阶级提升的人已经屈服于这种崇尚享受和娱乐而不用顾忌通常由其他人来承担成本的文化。
entries.en: This society rejoices in its own perfection. Those who are elevated by their privileged social structure have surrendered to a culture which glorifies pleasure and entertainment, regardless of a cost typically borne by others.

entries.zh: 工作就是你想去的地方。这个寰宇企业的公民愉快地宣誓效忠于他们的雇主——并奉献他们所有的空闲时间——以换取奢华的企业级享受。
entries.en: Work is where you want to be. The citizens of this Megacorporation happily pledge allegiance - and all their free time - to their employers in exchange for lavish corporate comforts.

entries.zh: 这家寰宇企业将其生产流水线完全集中在最高质量和利润率的商品上，创造和营销具有艺术性和工艺性的极致产品。
entries.en: This megacorporation has focused its production pipeline solely on goods of the highest quality and profit margins, creating and marketing stunning products with artistry and craft.

entries.zh: 这个社会对自身的至高无上深信不疑，只要不是他们主动发起的外交活动，他们都将视而不见。
entries.en: A society so utterly convinced of their own superiority, that any attempt at diplomacy not initiated by themselves will be utterly ignored.

entries.zh: 这个帝国孜孜不倦的终极目标是对更高完成度的追求。
entries.en: The ultimate goal of this empire is to ascend to ever greater levels of fulfillment.

entries.zh: $t$—游戏开始时殖民地拥有§G+1§!§Y飞升等级§!。
entries.en: $t$- Colonies have §G+1§! §YAscension Tier§! on game start.

entries.zh: 该蜂巢思维格外关注自身存在的形而上学健康，持续追寻自我提升的方法。
entries.en: The Hive Mind is particularly concerned with the metaphysical health of its being, and continually seeks means of self-improvement.

entries.zh: 荒野对其星球整体的形而上学健康抱有崇高的愿望。
entries.en: This Wilderness holds lofty aspirations for the metaphysical health of its integral worlds.

entries.zh: 该机械只能在异常地专注于自身形而上学层面的核心算法。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence is unusually obsessed with the metaphysical aspects of its core algorithms.

entries.zh: 这个社会的成员平等负担合作社企业的劳动，分享利润，共同实现远大抱负。
entries.en: Members of this society enjoy an equal share in the labors, profits and aspirations of the cooperative's ventures.

entries.zh: 该机械智能优化了黑客和监控协议。其核心指令是不择手段地获取信息。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence has optimized hacking and surveillance protocols. Information acquisition by any means necessary is one of its core directives.

entries.zh: 该机械智能特化于轨道操作和资源采集。它的低级子个体在地表任务上表现欠佳。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence is specialized in orbital operations and resource collection. Its menial drones perform poorly in planetside tasks.
